event.reason: Step to the Prisma DB schema generation after requirements analysis

event.thinking: Based on strict analysis of the schema for tables and component extraction, the previous errors indicate that the table names do not match the required snake_case pattern for database tables. The correct pattern is all lowercase with underscores, no capital letters (e.g., shoppingmall_products, shoppingmall_cart_items). The prefix should be lowercase and joined using underscores for compound words. Adjust all table names and schema filenames to lowercase snake_case only. All other logic, grouping, and domain reasoning remain unchanged from the previous analysis, simply regularizing to lowercase and underscores for names, e.g., shoppingmall_products, shoppingmall_admins, shoppingmall_orders, etc. This ensures JSON schema compliance on naming conventions for Prisma.
event.review: Complete replacement of all PascalCase or camelCase patterns in schema filenames and table names with strict lowercase snake_case. Checked for compound words being joined by underscores and confirmed no uppercase or mixed-casing appears. All domain/component boundaries are maintained as before, so the result will be functionally identical but strictly compliant with naming pattern expectations for both schema filenames and table names.
event.decision: Rename all component filenames and all table names to use lowercase snake_case, keeping the 'shoppingmall_' prefix. Each domain remains as previously structured. This will meet the snake_case and naming pattern validation for all extracted files and tables.

components.thinking: Channel, section, template, and system setting tables form the configuration core for all platform operations. These must be initialized before user/business operations. System audit, event, and logging enable omnichannel support and traceability.
components.review: All structure/configuration and global settings are foundational. Table names are strictly in lowercase snake_case per convention and requirement.
components.rationale: Platform-wide configuration and systemic tracking is defined up front for scalability and compliance.

components.thinking: All entities representing platform actors (end users, sellers, admins) along with related session, assignment, and identity management must be centralized. This domain also tracks verification and security for regulatory compliance.
components.review: Tables strictly follow lowercase snake_case naming. No cross-domain mixing—only identity and auth/role logic present.
components.rationale: Separation of ID/auth domains avoids coupling business logic to system-level security/auth flows.

components.thinking: All catalog/product/category logic, including options, versioning, taxonomy/templates, tags, and marketing content, plus inventory/snapshot/SEO. These drive discovery, sales, and compliance for SKUs.
components.review: All product-side tables are listed in proper lower_snake_case, following strict naming rules.
components.rationale: Domain encapsulation for product management ensures audit, scalability, and regulatory alignment.

components.thinking: Session-based cart functionality, including cart items, snapshots, abandoned carts, and cross-channel linking. Essential for multi-device commerce and seamless checkout.
components.review: All table names have been regularized to snake_case as required; cross-domain links remain purely referential.
components.rationale: Cart logic separated from orders to support frequent session changes and high-volume transient data.

components.thinking: Handles all transaction flows: primary/sub-orders, order items, payments, shipments, status transitions, refund/return flows, disputes, and evidence tracking, supporting full audit.
components.review: Confirmed all names in snake_case; structure aligns with robust DDD and regulatory traceability.
components.rationale: Core transaction flows/kpis are separated for scale and reliability; order/evidence relationships allow compliance handling.

components.thinking: Coupon, deposit, and mileage management—template creation through issuance/redemption/audit. Includes benefit snapshots, error, and adjustment logs.
components.review: Strict lower_snake_case naming, no cross-mixing with orders or actors.
components.rationale: Promotion/reward rules kept separate for flexibility, analytics, and retroactive policy changes.

components.thinking: Community and UGC: articles, comments, inquiries, answers, reviews/responses, bulletins, reports, moderation, and thread stats/audit.
components.review: Enforced lower_snake_case for all tables; content types are grouped as required for compliance, audit, and separation-of-concerns.
components.rationale: Isolated content layer enables rapid change, content moderation, reporting, and analytics.

components.thinking: Stores all favorite/bookmark logic and snapshots, tied to specific entities (products, inquiries, addresses), including recover/notify flows. Analytics-enabled for engagement KPIs.
components.review: All table patterns now comply with schema naming conventions. Domain separation enables fast queries and clean rollback/restoration flows.
components.rationale: Personalization is modular for robust horizontal scaling, without impacting product/content/order logic.

components.thinking: Encapsulates all document/media logic: attachment tracking, business-object linking, quarantine, appeal, retention, and compliance audit.
components.review: Final table names strictly match snake_case pattern. No cross-entity contamination—only references for enforcement/audit.
components.rationale: Attachments/files isolated for security, compliance, versioning, and role-based access requirements.

components.thinking: Universal business rule assignment, application, validation errors, evidence, legal holds, regulatory/compliance mappings, event logs, and incident reporting. Centralized for audit, policy, and global correction.
components.review: Lower_snake_case enforced for every table. This domain never mixes transactional/content records—strictly rules/evidence/compliance.
components.rationale: Centralizing cross-domain logic/rules allows agile business correction and regulatory audit while isolating risk.

My Target Component: Actors - schema-02-actors.prisma
Tables I Must Create: shoppingmall_customers, shoppingmall_sellers, shoppingmall_admins, shoppingmall_sessions, shoppingmall_role_assignments, shoppingmall_actor_profiles, shoppingmall_auth_verifications, shoppingmall_role_change_audits
Required Count: 8
Already Created Tables (Reference Only): [multiple shoppingmall_* tables such as products, categories, carts, orders, coupons, articles, attachment, etc. — for foreign key reference in case it's needed, but NOT to be created in this file.]

DESIGN PLANNING:
✅ I will create exactly 8 models from targetComponent.tables
✅ I will use EXACT table names as provided (NO CHANGES)
✅ I will use otherTables only for foreign key relationships (they ALREADY EXIST)
✅ I will add junction tables if needed for M:N relationships (e.g., role assignments)
✅ I will identify materialized views (none here; no mv_ prefix in these table names)
✅ I will ensure strict 3NF normalization for all regular tables

Strategically, this component handles all actor identity/role entities. Each table has clear business purpose: customers, sellers, admins (separate for compliance/auditability), sessions (per-actor, multi-channel), role assignments (tracks who has which roles, when, and how assigned/removed), actor profiles (business info, linkage to customer/seller/admin), auth verifications (stores temp keys/tokens for 2FA, resets, onboarding), and role change audits (immutable audit trail for role mutations). No business data mixing — strictly ID/authentication/role related info. Snapshots (esp. for role change audit) ensure regulatory compliance. Normalization is strictly enforced. Foreign keys reference only within actors domain, or to otherTables if actor events need context (unlikely for these tables).

Primarily referenced by orders, carts, reviews, favorites, and all customer-driven flows. Maintains only ID/auth and basic status for separation of concerns. Role assignments, sessions, and profiles handled in respective tables.

models.name: shoppingmall_products
models.description: Represents a single product listing in the shopping mall catalog, including base business, pricing, descriptive, and compliance-related data. Major relationships include options (shoppingmall_product_options), media (shoppingmall_product_media), associated tags (via shoppingmall_product_tags), and snapshot versioning (shoppingmall_product_snapshots). Main lifecycle: sellers create, update, and deactivate products; admins may moderate or suspend. Historical state is preserved via @link shoppingmall_product_snapshots.

The Orders component schema will cover all transactional, evidence, and lifecycle states for shoppingMall orders, supporting auditability, refunds, returns, payment flows, shipment, compliance, and dispute resolution. models.name: shoppingmall_orders
models.description: Main order entity for the shoppingMall platform. Stores core order information, customer/seller references, channel origins, parent-child linkage (split orders), top-line financials (non-calculated), address/delivery data, order status, and assignment to compliance/evidence flows. Links to snapshots, sub-orders, order items, payments, shipments, refunds, returns, disputes, and status logs. Full audit and regulatory preservation. Referenced by sub-orders, payments, status logs, evidence, etc.

event.review:
After reviewing the Coupons namespace schema, I found it generally shows strong compliance with normalization, business requirements, indexing, and documentation. Foreign key relationships are clearly defined to actors (customers, sellers, admins), and temporal fields are present for audit and regulatory needs. All major benefit flows (coupon issuance, redemption, mileage, deposit, audit trail) are represented in atomic, normalized tables. Several composite and GIN indexes support high-availability querying and integrity. However, there are a few areas requiring attention: 

- Some optional business fields (such as references to orders or actors) are not documented with full referential clarity and could benefit from explicit foreign keys, though their use as nullable is justified. 
- There are no materialized views for denormalized benefit analytics, which is acceptable, but should be monitored as usage patterns grow. 
- Uniqueness constraints and indexes appear sound given query and entity requirements. 
- The naming conventions are consistent (snake_case, plural), and model descriptions properly clarify business context.

Recommendations:
1. Maintain regular review of evolving coupon/mileage stacking rules to ensure schema flexibility as benefit logic becomes more complex.
2. Consider introducing summary/materialized views if analytics/reporting requirements grow intensive on benefit usage.
3. Continue to ensure all foreign key fields (especially nullable ones relating to user actions) have clear documentation for business logic reference.

No critical or major issues requiring model modifications were found. The schema supports all EARS requirements and business workflows defined in the requirements analysis. No modifications are required at this time.

Primary linkage is to sub-order; supports multi-shipment and partial fulfillment. All critical operations and evidence linked for compliance. Supports returns, disputes, and delivery tracking/audit.

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_sub_order_id
foreignFields.description: Related sub-order to which shipment is attached {@link shoppingmall_sub_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: shipment_code
plainFields.description: Internal shipment/tracking code for business use.

plainFields.name: carrier
plainFields.description: Logistics company or carrier reference (business-facing).

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Carrier-assigned tracking id/code.

plainFields.name: fulfillment_status
plainFields.description: Shipment fulfillment status (pending, ready, in_transit, delivered, returned, cancelled, failed, lost, on_hold).

plainFields.name: shipped_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp parcel was handed off to carrier/logistics.

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp parcel was officially delivered/accepted.

plainFields.name: returned_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of return-to-sender or failed delivery (if returned).

plainFields.name: delivery_address_json
plainFields.description: JSON serial of the delivery/shipping address used (immutable for audit).

plainFields.name: received_by
plainFields.description: Name or contact of person who physically received parcel, as known at delivery time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Created timestamp for shipment record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Updated timestamp for shipment record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete, if shipment voided/erased.

models.name: shoppingmall_order_status_logs
models.description: Immutable audit trail of all order & sub-order status transitions, with actor, status before/after, timestamp, channel/context, and linkage to compliance evidence where needed. Enables full lifecycle reconstruction for audit/compliance/dispute. Used by admins for root cause and SLA monitoring. Status log is append-only, write-once. Channel context for multi-channel orders is preserved. Links to orders, sub-orders, and evidence snapshots.

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Main order mapped to this status change log {@link shoppingmall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_sub_order_id
foreignFields.description: Sub-order mapped to this status change log (if applicable) {@link shoppingmall_sub_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_actor_id
foreignFields.description: Actor account triggering status change (customer, seller, admin) {@link shoppingmall_actor_profiles.id}.

plainFields.name: action_channel
plainFields.description: Channel/platform where status change originated (web, mobile, api, admin).

plainFields.name: status_before
plainFields.description: Status before change occurred.

plainFields.name: status_after
plainFields.description: Status after change occurred.

plainFields.name: transition_reason
plainFields.description: Business reason or code for status transition.

plainFields.name: transition_memo
plainFields.description: Arbitrary business logic memo or note for this transition (internal/audit only).

plainFields.name: transition_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp at which status change took place.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for log record.

models.name: shoppingmall_order_snapshots
models.description: Immutable full-order snapshots for audit and compliance. Captures the complete state (all business fields) of orders at critical points (creation, payment, fulfillment, refund, dispute, etc.) for evidence/audit purposes. Enables historical restoration, regulatory export, and state transition analysis. Snapshot data are denormalized JSON blobs, not real-time editable. Linked to original order.

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order to which this snapshot belongs {@link shoppingmall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: snapshot_type
plainFields.description: Nature of snapshot event (created, paid, shipped, delivered, refunded, disputed, etc.).

plainFields.name: snapshot_data_json
plainFields.description: Serialized JSON of the full order+items+shipments state at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot record creation timestamp.

models.name: shoppingmall_order_refunds
models.description: Refund/return payment flows attached to an order and often a sub-order or specific item. Tracks refund amount, payment association, reason, admin handling, and full audit trail for regulatory/compliance. Linked to original payment, refund evidence, and status transitions. Governance for partial/complete refunds, audit recovery, and regulatory SLA compliance. No calculated fields (all values snapped at refund event).

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Parent order {@link shoppingmall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_payment_id
foreignFields.description: Original payment transaction related to refund {@link shoppingmall_order_payments.id}.

plainFields.name: refund_code
plainFields.description: Unique refund transaction code (business/audit ref).

plainFields.name: refund_amount
plainFields.description: Refunded amount for this event as of the snapshot.

plainFields.name: refund_status
plainFields.description: Current refund status (pending, success, failed, cancelled, on_hold, disputed).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided for this refund, business/audit context.

plainFields.name: requested_by_role
plainFields.description: Role requesting refund (customer, seller, admin).

plainFields.name: processed_by_role
plainFields.description: Role processing/approving refund (admin, seller, system).

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp refund was requested/submitted.

plainFields.name: processed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp processed/approved/denied/failed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Refund record creation timestamp (business audit).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Refund record last updated (audit trail/compliance).

models.name: shoppingmall_order_returns
models.description: Return requests (prior to refund) attached to orders, sub-orders, and items. Contains business logic for eligibility (date, condition), scope, reason, and processing details. Linked to refund flows when approved. Tracks processing/admin roles, evidence, and audit trail for regulatory. Supports multi-item, partial, or complete returns per order. Each return record is uniquely linked to order, items, and refund when approved.

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order containing the item(s) to return {@link shoppingmall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_refund_id
foreignFields.description: Refund record created if/when return is approved/paid {@link shoppingmall_order_refunds.id}.

plainFields.name: return_code
plainFields.description: Unique return request code for audit/business trace.

plainFields.name: return_type
plainFields.description: Type: full or partial (itemized).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled, returned, completed, failed, on_hold).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer/business reason for initiating return.

plainFields.name: item_list_json
plainFields.description: JSON array of items and quantities to return (structured for itemized returns).

plainFields.name: requested_by_role
plainFields.description: Who initiated: customer, seller, or admin?

plainFields.name: processed_by_role
plainFields.description: Approver/process role: admin, seller, system.

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: Return requested timestamp.

plainFields.name: processed_at
plainFields.description: Return processing/approval/denial time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Return record creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update to return record.

models.name: shoppingmall_disputes
models.description: Formal disputes raised regarding order, payment, refund, or delivery. Contains status, subject type, related objects, open/close details, reason, and evidentiary snapshot. Enables compliance and legal handling; supports foreign linkages to refund, return, shipment, and order evidence. Used for regulatory/consumer issues and audit compliance.

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Main (root) order subject of dispute {@link shoppingmall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_refund_id
foreignFields.description: Refund in dispute if applicable {@link shoppingmall_order_refunds.id}.

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_return_id
foreignFields.description: Return in dispute if applicable {@link shoppingmall_order_returns.id}.

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_shipment_id
foreignFields.description: Shipment/fulfillment in dispute if applicable {@link shoppingmall_order_shipments.id}.

plainFields.name: dispute_code
plainFields.description: Globally unique dispute identifier for audit.

plainFields.name: dispute_type
plainFields.description: Nature of dispute (order, refund, return, shipment, product, etc.).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status (pending, open, resolved, rejected, cancelled, escalated, on_hold, closed).

plainFields.name: opened_by_role
plainFields.description: Role that initiated dispute (customer, seller, admin).

plainFields.name: opened_at
plainFields.description: Dispute case opened time.

plainFields.name: closed_by_role
plainFields.description: Role closing the dispute (admin, seller, customer, system).

plainFields.name: closed_at
plainFields.description: Case closed time (if resolved or rejected).

plainFields.name: dispute_subject_json
plainFields.description: JSON snapshot of disputed object context (order, payment, refund, delivery, product).

plainFields.name: resolution_summary_json
plainFields.description: JSON narrative/structure of how dispute was settled (compliance/legal trace).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Dispute record creation (audit).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update to dispute record.

models.name: shoppingmall_order_evidence
models.description: Evidence and audit-trail linkage table for all order-related compliance events (creation, update, refund, dispute, return, shipment). Records event, type, business context, actor, and snapshot. Enables full traceability for legal, SLA, or regulatory requirements. Supports bulk/batch download for legal hold or regulatory export.

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order this evidence is bound to {@link shoppingmall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_actor_id
foreignFields.description: Actor (user, seller, admin) who created this evidence (links to audit/compliance user profile) {@link shoppingmall_actor_profiles.id}.

plainFields.name: evidence_type
plainFields.description: Nature/type: creation, payment_submit, payment_complete, shipment, delivery, refund, return, dispute, cancellation, compliance, system, etc.

plainFields.name: evidence_context_json
plainFields.description: Serialized JSON of the business context for evidence (order, payment, reason, files, etc.).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Evidence record creation time.

models.name: shoppingmall_coupon_templates
models.description: Defines the master templates for coupons, including rules for benefit calculation, eligibility, allowed stacking, redemption windows, and associated metadata. This table structures business logic applicable to batches of issued coupons and supports both platform (admin) and seller-originated campaigns. Supports audit trails for retroactive policy changes and analytics for benefit optimization.

foreignFields.name: created_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin's {@link shoppingmall_admins.id} who created this coupon template.

foreignFields.name: created_by_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller's {@link shoppingmall_sellers.id} who created this coupon template (nullable if admin-created).

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Type of coupon: one of fixed_amount, percentage, free_shipping, etc. Used for determining benefit calculation logic.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Business-facing name of the coupon template.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Long-form business description for the template, explaining business context, user eligibility, and restriction rules.

plainFields.name: start_at
plainFields.description: Window start timestamp when coupons based on this template become valid for redemption.

plainFields.name: end_at
plainFields.description: Window end timestamp after which no more coupons from this template can be issued or redeemed.

plainFields.name: min_order_amount
plainFields.description: Business rule: minimum order amount required to enable coupon usage (if applicable).

plainFields.name: max_discount_amount
plainFields.description: Maximum discount amount allowed for this template, used to cap value in percent-based or stackable offers.

plainFields.name: issued_quantity
plainFields.description: Total number of coupons issued from this template.

plainFields.name: allowed_uses_per_user
plainFields.description: Maximum number of times a single user can redeem coupons from this template.

plainFields.name: combinable
plainFields.description: Indicates whether coupons using this template can be stacked (combined) with others in a single order.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Shows if the template is currently active (no subsequent issuance if false).

plainFields.name: metadata_json
plainFields.description: Business extensibility field for extra metadata (JSON encoded for flexible business logic).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Template creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last template modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-deletion timestamp, null until business removal required.

models.name: shoppingmall_coupons
models.description: Represents individual coupons issued to the platform or sellers, inheriting rules from the template table. Tracks coupon code, assignment, status, and base eligibility parameters (e.g., target user, valid window, original value).

foreignFields.name: coupon_template_id
foreignFields.description: Originating template's {@link shoppingmall_coupon_templates.id}.

plainFields.name: coupon_code
plainFields.description: Globally unique code or identifier for the coupon (redeemable by user at checkout).

plainFields.name: assigned_to_customer_id
plainFields.description: Customer's {@link shoppingmall_customers.id} this coupon is assigned to (nullable until claimed or issued).

plainFields.name: issued_to_seller_id
plainFields.description: Seller's {@link shoppingmall_sellers.id} if coupon is restricted to a specific seller (nullable if platform-wide).

plainFields.name: issued_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this coupon was issued to user or made available for claim.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Business expiry date for this coupon (cannot be redeemed after this point even if template valid).

plainFields.name: redeemed
plainFields.description: State flag indicating if coupon has been redeemed at least once.

plainFields.name: locked
plainFields.description: If true, this coupon is temporarily or permanently locked by business/validation rules (e.g., fraud, dispute, compliance).

plainFields.name: metadata_json
plainFields.description: Business extensibility: optional JSON for assigning additional metadata, campaign info, or error traces.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Coupon creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Coupon last updated timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-deletion timestamp, null unless business removal required.

models.name: shoppingmall_coupon_issuances
models.description: Tracks every coupon issued from a template, identifying the actor (admin or seller), time, method (bulk, direct, user-claim), and context. This model is used for benefit auditing and campaign analytics.

foreignFields.name: coupon_id
foreignFields.description: Issued coupon's {@link shoppingmall_coupons.id}.

foreignFields.name: issued_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin's {@link shoppingmall_admins.id} who issued the coupon (if admin-driven).

foreignFields.name: issued_by_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller's {@link shoppingmall_sellers.id} if coupon issued by seller, null if platform-only.

plainFields.name: issue_method
plainFields.description: Describes business method of issuance: e.g., 'direct_assign', 'bulk_event', 'self_claimed', etc.

plainFields.name: context_json
plainFields.description: Additional business context of issuance (trigger event, segmentation, batch info, etc.), JSON encoded.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this issuance was created.

models.name: shoppingmall_coupon_redemptions
models.description: Records each redemption event for coupons. Links coupon, redeemer (customer), redemption context, result, and timestamps. Used for enforcement of benefit usage rules and benefit dispute evidence.

foreignFields.name: coupon_id
foreignFields.description: Coupon's {@link shoppingmall_coupons.id} being redeemed.

foreignFields.name: redeemed_by_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's {@link shoppingmall_customers.id} who redeemed the coupon.

plainFields.name: order_id
plainFields.description: Order's {@link shoppingmall_orders.id} where coupon was used (if known at time of redemption).

plainFields.name: benefit_amount
plainFields.description: Amount of benefit redeemed (currency value for discount or actual value of benefit).

plainFields.name: redemption_result
plainFields.description: Outcome/result status of redemption: e.g., 'success', 'failed_minimum', 'expired', 'disputed'.

plainFields.name: redemption_context_json
plainFields.description: Business context for redemption (e.g., reasoning, cart snapshot), JSON encoded.

plainFields.name: redeemed_at
plainFields.description: Redemption event timestamp.

models.name: shoppingmall_mileage_ledger
models.description: Records all mileage (loyalty point) accruals and deductions for users—including initial award, promotional boosters, redemptions, expirations, reversals, and admin/seller/manual adjustments. Supports full auditability by point origin, value, event, and status.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's {@link shoppingmall_customers.id} who owns this ledger record.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin's {@link shoppingmall_admins.id} who performed manual mileage adjustment (nullable if system-driven).

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller's {@link shoppingmall_sellers.id} who performed mileage adjustment (nullable if not seller-driven event).

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Describes the business event: e.g., 'order_award','coupon_bonus','redemption','expiration','manual_adjustment'.

plainFields.name: mileage_delta
plainFields.description: Number of points accrued (+) or deducted (-) from user's balance in this event.

plainFields.name: related_order_id
plainFields.description: Order's {@link shoppingmall_orders.id} linked to this mileage event (null if not order-related).

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Free-form admin or business-facing notes, e.g., explanation for manual adjustment or error context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Mileage event creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when mileage expires (null if not expired or not per-point expiry model).

models.name: shoppingmall_deposit_ledger
models.description: Tracks all deposit balance-related activities for a user, including top-ups, deductions for orders, refunds, expiration, and provider-based adjustments. Supports full business/audit trace from original event to each impact on the user's account.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's {@link shoppingmall_customers.id} whose deposit balance is impacted.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin's {@link shoppingmall_admins.id} performing deposit action (if not system-driven).

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Describes the deposit business event: e.g., 'topup','order_payment','refund', 'expiration','manual_adjustment'.

plainFields.name: amount_delta
plainFields.description: Deposited (+) or deducted (-) amount of funds (platform currency units).

plainFields.name: related_order_id
plainFields.description: Order's {@link shoppingmall_orders.id} if event is related to an order transaction.

plainFields.name: provider
plainFields.description: Payment provider identifier (e.g., 'credit_card','bank_transfer','voucher', etc.).

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Admin or system notes for business/audit/exception context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Deposit event creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when deposit expires (if per-transaction expiration/policy applies).

models.name: shoppingmall_benefit_snapshots
models.description: Historical business snapshots of user benefit entitlements at the time of issuance, redemption, or adjustment—used for compliance, disputes, legal evidence, and retroactive benefit restoration. Stores point-in-time, immutable business records for every coupon, mileage, or deposit event.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's {@link shoppingmall_customers.id} whose benefit entitlement is snapshotted.

plainFields.name: benefit_type
plainFields.description: Type of benefit at snapshot: 'coupon', 'mileage', or 'deposit'.

plainFields.name: source_id
plainFields.description: ID of the source entity (coupon_id, mileage_ledger_id, or deposit_ledger_id as applicable).

plainFields.name: snapshot_json
plainFields.description: Full snapshot of business state and entitlements at point-in-time (JSON encoded).

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Triggering event: 'issuance', 'redemption', 'adjustment', 'expiration', 'rollback', etc.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot creation timestamp.

models.name: shoppingmall_benefit_audit
models.description: Immutable, tamper-evident audit log for all benefit (coupon, mileage, deposit) events, including issuance, redemption, expiration, failure, and business corrections. Critical for compliance, business rule enforcement, and regulatory retrieval.

foreignFields.name: source_id
foreignFields.description: Source entity for audit (may refer to coupon, mileage, or deposit entry).

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's {@link shoppingmall_customers.id} whose benefit action is being audited.

plainFields.name: benefit_type
plainFields.description: Type of benefit impacted: 'coupon', 'mileage', or 'deposit'.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Business event: 'issuance', 'redemption','expiration','manual_correction','auto_expire', 'dispute', etc.

plainFields.name: event_context_json
plainFields.description: Business context or metadata for this event (JSON encoded).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Audit event creation timestamp.

models.name: shoppingmall_coupon_errors
models.description: Represents business, eligibility, validation, and redemption errors related to coupon usage. Used to improve user experience, root cause analysis, and business policy refinement. Supports both user-facing and internal error reporting.

foreignFields.name: coupon_id
foreignFields.description: Coupon's {@link shoppingmall_coupons.id} related to this error event.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's {@link shoppingmall_customers.id} affected by this error occurrence.

plainFields.name: error_code
plainFields.description: Application/business error code (e.g., 'COUPON_EXPIRED', 'COUPON_INELIGIBLE').

plainFields.name: error_message
plainFields.description: User-facing or system error message explaining cause and suggested remediation.

plainFields.name: business_context_json
plainFields.description: Optional serialized business context for error (JSON encoded).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Error event occurrence timestamp.

models.name: shoppingmall_articles
models.description: Business articles and editorial posts for the shoppingMall community and platform. Managed by admins or authorized sellers, these support platform news, guides, major updates, editorial content, and feature rollouts. Audience is customers and sellers. Threaded comments, content snapshots, and compliance audit tracked via related models. Subject to moderation, reporting, and analytics through related entities.

foreignFields.name: created_by_id
foreignFields.description: Actor's {@link shoppingmall_actor_profiles.id} who created the article.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Article title. Shown in listings, SEO, and notifications.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Full published content of the article. May include rich formatting.

plainFields.name: summary
plainFields.description: Short summary for preview or search result snippets. Typically 100-300 chars.

plainFields.name: cover_image_uri
plainFields.description: Cover image for this article, used in lists and previews. Must be a valid image URI or file reference.

plainFields.name: pinned
plainFields.description: Whether this article is currently pinned at the top of listing pages or dashboards. Admin only.

plainFields.name: published_at
plainFields.description: Datetime article was made public. Null if draft or pending.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of initial article creation. Immutable, for evidence and audit.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of most recent edit. For audit and dashboard display.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion flag. Set when logically deleted, retained for compliance and evidence.

models.name: shoppingmall_comments
models.description: Threaded comments for UGC articles, inquiries, reviews, or bulletins. Supports nested replies via parent-child hierarchy. Moderation, reporting, evidence, and analytics handled by related models. Each comment links to content target, owning actor, and may be soft-deleted.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Self-referential. The parent comment's {@link shoppingmall_comments.id}, for nested comment threads.

foreignFields.name: thread_id
foreignFields.description: The root thread's {@link shoppingmall_thread_statistics.id} this comment belongs to, grouping all comments for a single content object.

foreignFields.name: author_id
foreignFields.description: Actor's {@link shoppingmall_actor_profiles.id} who posted the comment.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Comment message content. Plain text or optionally formatted by policy.

plainFields.name: edited
plainFields.description: Whether this comment has been edited after initial submission. Used for audit and display.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when comment was first created. Immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when comment was last edited. Changes if edited=true.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion field. Null unless deleted.

models.name: shoppingmall_inquiries
models.description: Product, service, or bulletin Q&A inquiries initiated by authenticated users. Each inquiry is linked to a product, article, or bulletin (via foreign key or thread linkage), supports status tracking, moderation, and evidence/audit via snapshots. Answers are managed in separate table. Reporting, flagging, and compliance handled via related entities.

foreignFields.name: thread_id
foreignFields.description: The root thread's {@link shoppingmall_thread_statistics.id} for this inquiry (groups all posts: Q&A, comments, stats, etc.).

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Inquiry by customer's {@link shoppingmall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_product_id
foreignFields.description: Target product's {@link shoppingmall_products.id} (if product inquiry).

foreignFields.name: target_article_id
foreignFields.description: Target article's {@link shoppingmall_articles.id} (if article inquiry).

foreignFields.name: target_bulletin_id
foreignFields.description: Target bulletin's {@link shoppingmall_bulletins.id} (if bulletin inquiry).

plainFields.name: question
plainFields.description: Full inquiry question submitted by user. Subject to profanity check, validation. Min 10, max 1000 characters.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Business status code of inquiry: pending, answered, closed, or escalated, per business rules.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of inquiry submission. Immutable, for evidence and search.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of most recent inquiry update or status change.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion. Set when logically removed for compliance, evidence, or policy.

models.name: shoppingmall_inquiry_answers
models.description: Official answers (from seller or admin) to inquiries. Answers are 1:1 with inquiries but may support edits and history (tracked by snapshots). Clearly associated to responding actor, with audit and compliance requirements. Used for business/role escalation workflows.

foreignFields.name: inquiry_id
foreignFields.description: Target inquiry's {@link shoppingmall_inquiries.id} being answered.

foreignFields.name: responder_id
foreignFields.description: Actor's {@link shoppingmall_actor_profiles.id} who responded. Must be seller or admin.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Answer message content. May support rich text or formatting depending on business logic.

plainFields.name: edited
plainFields.description: Whether this answer has been edited after initial submission. Used for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when answer was first created. Immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when answer was last edited. Changes if edited=true.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion field. Set when answer removed logically, retained for audit.

models.name: shoppingmall_reviews
models.description: Product, service, or seller reviews entered by customers after purchase/fulfillment. Each review links to a thread, the reviewed entity (product or seller), and the submitting customer. Supported features: star rating, text content, optional media, moderation, reporting, and analytics. Review edits and compliance evidence retained via snapshots.

foreignFields.name: thread_id
foreignFields.description: The root thread's {@link shoppingmall_thread_statistics.id} for this review and all replies/posts.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Authoring customer's {@link shoppingmall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_product_id
foreignFields.description: Reviewed product's {@link shoppingmall_products.id}. Null if not a product review.

foreignFields.name: target_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reviewed seller's {@link shoppingmall_sellers.id}. Null if not seller review.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Business review score. 1 to 5 stars, inclusive. Enforced by validation logic.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short review title, used in lists or search. Optional.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Review content body. Min 10, max 2000 characters. Must pass validation and moderation.

plainFields.name: verified_purchase
plainFields.description: Indicates if review is from a verified purchase/order (for business trust badge display).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of review submission. Immutable, for time-based sort or evidence.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of most recent review update (body, title, etc).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, if removed logically for policy/compliance.

models.name: shoppingmall_review_replies
models.description: Authoritative replies to reviews from sellers or admins. One reply per review. Replies support moderation, edits, evidence/audit, and can be flagged for abuse. Each is associated to a review and responding actor role.

foreignFields.name: review_id
foreignFields.description: Target review's {@link shoppingmall_reviews.id} being replied to.

foreignFields.name: responder_id
foreignFields.description: Actor's {@link shoppingmall_actor_profiles.id} replying to the review. Usually a seller or admin.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Reply message content, including moderation notes or acknowledgments.

plainFields.name: edited
plainFields.description: Whether this reply has been edited after submission. Required for evidence and audit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation datetime of review reply. Immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of most recent edit to reply.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion flag. Set when reply logically deleted (policy/compliance).

models.name: shoppingmall_bulletins
models.description: Bulletin board posts and platform-wide announcements. Created mainly by admins but can be posted by designated sellers for community marketing, legal, or major campaign notices. Supports pinning, expiration, and visibility logic. Audit and content evidence preserved for compliance uses. Comments and reporting supported via related models.

foreignFields.name: author_id
foreignFields.description: Actor's {@link shoppingmall_actor_profiles.id} who posted the bulletin (admin or seller).

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Bulletin headline or title. Used for listings, links, and notifications.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Bulletin message content. Can include formatting, images, or legal text.

plainFields.name: pinned
plainFields.description: If the bulletin is currently pinned at the top of listings. Admin only.

plainFields.name: visible_to
plainFields.description: Visibility policy: all, customers, sellers, or admin-only. Used to restrict who sees a post.

plainFields.name: expire_at
plainFields.description: Optional expiration; bulletin hidden after this date for users.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of creation. Immutable, for evidence and compliance.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of last edit or update. Tracked for moderation/audit.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion. Set when logically removed, but still retained for compliance period.

models.name: shoppingmall_reported_content
models.description: Business-level content abuse or violation reports filed by users or detected by automated systems. Supports multi-type (comment, review, bulletin, article, etc.) targeting, links to reporting actor, management status, and audit evidence. Used for moderation, compliance, and regulatory escalation when required.

foreignFields.name: reported_by_id
foreignFields.description: Actor's {@link shoppingmall_actor_profiles.id} who filed the report (customer, seller, or admin).

foreignFields.name: target_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Reported comment's {@link shoppingmall_comments.id}, if report is for a comment.

foreignFields.name: target_article_id
foreignFields.description: Reported article's {@link shoppingmall_articles.id}, if report is for article.

foreignFields.name: target_inquiry_id
foreignFields.description: Reported inquiry's {@link shoppingmall_inquiries.id}, if applicable.

foreignFields.name: target_review_id
foreignFields.description: Reported review's {@link shoppingmall_reviews.id}, if applicable.

foreignFields.name: target_bulletin_id
foreignFields.description: Reported bulletins's {@link shoppingmall_bulletins.id}, if applicable.

plainFields.name: reason_code
plainFields.description: Machine- or user-generated reason code: spam, abuse, fraud, policy, legal, etc. Used for escalation path and analytics.

plainFields.name: narrative
plainFields.description: Additional free-text context or details from the reporter. May be null for automated detection.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status of the report: open, reviewed, actioned, closed, escalated, etc. Tracked for compliance evidence.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Date/time report was filed or auto-generated. Immutable, for business logic and SLA audit.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Date/time of last moderation action or status update. Changes as review proceeds.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion for compliance evidence, set when logically removed.

models.name: shoppingmall_content_flags
models.description: Internal or user-triggered moderation flags on content. Used to mark possible abuse, offensive, or out-of-policy cases pending review. Actioned by admins, linked to flagged actor, content, and compliance/audit evidence. Subject to auto-escalation on threshold or legal/AI detection.

foreignFields.name: flagged_by_id
foreignFields.description: Actor's {@link shoppingmall_actor_profiles.id} who flagged the content (or system/AI).

foreignFields.name: target_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Flagged comment's {@link shoppingmall_comments.id}, if content is comment.

foreignFields.name: target_article_id
foreignFields.description: Flagged article's {@link shoppingmall_articles.id}, if content is article.

foreignFields.name: target_inquiry_id
foreignFields.description: Flagged inquiry's {@link shoppingmall_inquiries.id}, if content is inquiry.

foreignFields.name: target_review_id
foreignFields.description: Flagged review's {@link shoppingmall_reviews.id}, if content is review.

foreignFields.name: target_bulletin_id
foreignFields.description: Flagged bulletins's {@link shoppingmall_bulletins.id}, if content is bulletin.

plainFields.name: flag_type
plainFields.description: Flag category code: abuse, spam, copyright, prohibited, etc. Used for business rule/action routing.

plainFields.name: note
plainFields.description: Free-text note from actor, may include context or evidence pointer. May be null for automated/AI flags.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status of moderation: pending, reviewed, actioned, dismissed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When flagged record was created (user or automated). Immutable for evidence and audit.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Datetime last updated, typically by moderator or system.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion field for legal compliance/audit retention.

models.name: shoppingmall_content_snapshots
models.description: Immutable snapshots of content items (comments, reviews, inquiries, articles, bulletins, etc.) for compliance, audit, dispute resolution, or history navigation. Each links to original content, content type, and change context. Tied to thread and actor. Only created by business events (change, deletion, dispute, etc.).

foreignFields.name: thread_id
foreignFields.description: Content thread's {@link shoppingmall_thread_statistics.id} for full audit trail linkage.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: Actor's {@link shoppingmall_actor_profiles.id} who triggered the snapshot (admin, seller, customer, or system).

plainFields.name: content_type
plainFields.description: Content type: comment, review, inquiry, article, bulletin, etc. Used to interpret content_id and reconstruction.

plainFields.name: content_id
plainFields.description: UUID of the content object being snapshotted. Must correspond to correct type/target table.

plainFields.name: snapshot_body
plainFields.description: Full serialized snapshot of content at the time of event. Content structure depends on type.

plainFields.name: change_event
plainFields.description: Business code for what caused snapshot (create, edit, delete, moderation, dispute, etc.).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot creation datetime. Immutable evidence timestamp.

models.name: shoppingmall_thread_statistics
models.description: Materialized/statistics entity for each thread of user/community content (article, review thread, inquiry thread, bulletin thread, etc.). Stores denormalized statistics and trust signals (post count, like count, abuse count, moderation history) for performance analytics and UI display. Serves as anchor/root for comments and thread association. Managed as non-materialized business table for performance and audit requirements, not for direct content display.

plainFields.name: thread_type
plainFields.description: Thread context type: article, review, inquiry, bulletin, etc. Used for analytics and UGC linkage.

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: UUID of top-level content entity this thread is for (article, review, inquiry, etc).

plainFields.name: post_count
plainFields.description: Denormalized count of posts/comments/content in this thread. Used for analytics and query performance.

plainFields.name: like_count
plainFields.description: Like/upvote count associated with content in this thread. Used for trust/trending UI.

plainFields.name: abuse_report_count
plainFields.description: Count of abuse/report/flag submissions related to thread content. Tracked for moderation escalation and analytics.

plainFields.name: last_posted_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when last post was made to this thread (audit, recency ranking).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Thread statistics row creation datetime.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Datetime statistics row was last updated.

models.name: shoppingmall_favorites
models.description: Stores summary record of all favorites for a user, with role, entity-type, current status, and logical deletion. References user (customer, seller), relates to specific domains such as products, inquiries, or addresses. Central linking table for favorites logic. Used for managing favorites lifecycle, restoration, deactivation, and engagement analytics.

foreignFields.name: actor_profile_id
foreignFields.description: Actor performing the favoriting action. References the user's {@link shoppingmall_actor_profiles.id}.

plainFields.name: target_type
plainFields.description: Type of entity being favorited (e.g., 'product', 'inquiry', 'address'). Defines the linked domain for the favorite record.

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: ID of the entity being favorited, variable by type (product, inquiry, address).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when favorite was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when favorite was last updated (modify, restore, remove).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete indicator for favorite removal/reversal. Null if active.

models.name: shoppingmall_favorite_products
models.description: Links each favorite record to a detailed product snapshot to preserve product state as of favoriting. References shoppingmall_favorites and shoppingmall_products. Used for accurate historical display, recovery, and analytics on product changes versus time-of-favoriting.

foreignFields.name: favorite_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the master favorite record's {@link shoppingmall_favorites.id}.

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: Favorited product's {@link shoppingmall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: product_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product's state at the time of favoriting ({@link shoppingmall_product_snapshots.id}).

plainFields.name: product_title
plainFields.description: Product title when favorited, for fast favorite browsing UI.

plainFields.name: main_image_uri
plainFields.description: Main image URI as of favoriting for display in favorites list.

plainFields.name: price_at_favorite
plainFields.description: Product price at time of favoriting for audit/restoration.

plainFields.name: inventory_status
plainFields.description: Product inventory status (in_stock, out_of_stock, discontinued) at the time of favoriting.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of favorite-product snapshot creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to product favorite (UI refresh, restoration, etc.).

models.name: shoppingmall_favorite_inquiries
models.description: Links each favorite record to a product/inquiry Q&A, preserving relevant Q&A content, responder, and status as of favoriting. Supports evidence tracking and recovery workflows.

foreignFields.name: favorite_id
foreignFields.description: Favorite record's {@link shoppingmall_favorites.id}, unique per inquiry per actor.

foreignFields.name: inquiry_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced inquiry {@link shoppingmall_inquiries.id}.

foreignFields.name: inquiry_answer_id
foreignFields.description: Linked answer for the inquiry at time of favoriting, if answered ({@link shoppingmall_inquiry_answers.id}).

plainFields.name: question
plainFields.description: Inquiry question text at time of favorite action.

plainFields.name: answer
plainFields.description: Answer text, if available, at time of favorite action for snapshot/audit.

plainFields.name: responder_actor_profile_id
plainFields.description: Actor profile ID for responder of answer, if answered when favorited.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of favorite-inquiry record creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp, such as after answer is posted or user triggers refresh.

models.name: shoppingmall_favorite_addresses
models.description: Links a favorite record to a user address, capturing address details and preferences as of favoriting for autofill/recovery. Used for order flows and analytics on favorite address use and engagement.

foreignFields.name: favorite_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to {@link shoppingmall_favorites.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_profile_id
foreignFields.description: Owner profile for the favorite address, usually the same actor as the favorite action. References {@link shoppingmall_actor_profiles.id}.

plainFields.name: address_label
plainFields.description: Friendly label for display (e.g., 'Home', 'Office').

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Recipient's full name for shipping/delivery.

plainFields.name: postal_address
plainFields.description: Full postal address as string for autofill purposes.

plainFields.name: postcode
plainFields.description: Postal/ZIP code, validated per region.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Contact phone number for deliveries.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email for delivery/contact where captured.

plainFields.name: is_default
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether this is the default favorite address for the user.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of favorite-address snapshot creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for address (edit, restoration, etc.).

models.name: shoppingmall_favorite_snapshots
models.description: Stores immutable snapshots of the full favorite record and its target entity as of the favorite or recovery action. Enables policy-compliant auditing, recovery within time windows, and advanced engagement analytics. Provides a point-in-time export of favorite state.

foreignFields.name: favorite_id
foreignFields.description: Favorite record whose snapshot this represents. References {@link shoppingmall_favorites.id}.

plainFields.name: snapshot_type
plainFields.description: Action triggering this snapshot (created, restored, deleted, updated).

plainFields.name: snapshot_data
plainFields.description: JSON-encoded or stringified business state of the favorite and its entity at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot creation timestamp.

models.name: shoppingmall_favorite_events
models.description: Tracks all business-relevant events tied to a favorite (add, remove, restore, engagement, notification, failure). Used for event-driven workflows, analytics, and error recovery. Enables full history and auditing.

foreignFields.name: favorite_id
foreignFields.description: Related favorite's {@link shoppingmall_favorites.id}.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type of event (created, removed, restored, notified, failed, etc.)

plainFields.name: event_data
plainFields.description: Flexible JSON or data for more context about the event (if applicable).

plainFields.name: actor_profile_id
plainFields.description: Actor profile responsible for the event.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp the event occurred.

models.name: shoppingmall_favorite_notifications
models.description: Stores notification events sent to users for favorite entities (price drop, stock status, product change, restoration, etc.). References favorite and recipient profile. Used for engagement tracking and notification history/audit.

foreignFields.name: favorite_id
foreignFields.description: Favorite this notification relates to. References {@link shoppingmall_favorites.id}.

foreignFields.name: recipient_actor_profile_id
foreignFields.description: Recipient's profile for notification delivery; links to {@link shoppingmall_actor_profiles.id}.

plainFields.name: notification_type
plainFields.description: Business type of notification (price_drop, back_in_stock, removal, etc.).

plainFields.name: notification_data
plainFields.description: JSON or detail about the notification sent (e.g., old/new prices for price drop).

plainFields.name: sent_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp notification sent.

plainFields.name: read_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when user read/acknowledged the notification, null if unread.

models.name: shoppingmall_favorite_restore_logs
models.description: Stores detailed logs of favorite restoration actions (user-initiated or admin-initiated), including evidence, actor profile, justification, and timestamps. Enables robust auditing and compliance for recovery and legal erasure requests. Links to favorite, snapshot, and actor profile.

foreignFields.description: Favorite being restored. References {@link shoppingmall_favorites.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_profile_id
foreignFields.description: Actor profile (user or admin) who performed the restoration. References {@link shoppingmall_actor_profiles.id}.

foreignFields.name: favorite_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Snapshot used as basis for restoration ({@link shoppingmall_favorite_snapshots.id}).

plainFields.name: restore_reason
plainFields.description: Reason or context for restoration (user request, error reversal, compliance).

plainFields.name: evidence_data
plainFields.description: Auxiliary evidence or audit info (e.g., request object, attached files list).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp restore was performed.

models.name: shoppingmall_attachments
models.description: Represents every unique attachment (file object) uploaded to the platform. Tracks file-level identity and main business metadata. Core for secure file management, permission, and audit. Linked to file metadata, business objects (via links), and audit trails.

plainFields.name: originating_user_id
plainFields.description: ID of the user (customer, seller, or admin) who uploaded this attachment. Used for access tracking and role enforcement.

plainFields.name: uploaded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the file was uploaded to the system (ISO 8601).

plainFields.name: filename
plainFields.description: Name of the file as provided by uploader.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Lifecycle status: e.g., active, archived, quarantined, deleted, pending_moderation, rejected. Used for business workflows.

plainFields.name: purpose
plainFields.description: Business context for file, e.g., 'product_image', 'order_receipt', 'review_media', 'legal_evidence'.

plainFields.name: file_type

plainFields.name: file_size

plainFields.name: checksum
plainFields.description: Cryptographic hash (e.g., SHA-256) for file integrity verification.

plainFields.name: version_number
plainFields.description: Integer version for update/re-upload scenarios. Increments per modification.

plainFields.name: retention_policy
plainFields.description: Business or legal retention policy name/ID (e.g., 'default_5y', 'invoice_7y', 'temp_30d').

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: If soft deleted, when did this occur? Otherwise null.

models.name: shoppingmall_attachment_links
models.description: Junction table linking attachments to business objects (products, orders, reviews, inquiries) in the platform. Supports polymorphic associations with strict referential integrity. plainFields.name: target_table

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: ID of the business object this attachment is linked to.

plainFields.name: linked_by_user_id
plainFields.description: User who performed the link action (usually owner; could be admin for compliance attachments).

plainFields.name: linked_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp linkage created.

models.name: shoppingmall_file_metadata
models.description: Stores detailed metadata for each file/attachment beyond core fields: mime type, platform classification, retention, moderation flags, automated scan results, and compliance status. Used for advanced audit, compliance, and security scenarios.

foreignFields.name: attachment_id
foreignFields.description: Attachment for which this metadata record exists. {@link shoppingmall_attachments.id}

plainFields.name: metadata_json
plainFields.description: Structured business metadata (json). Includes detected labels, entities, extracted text, moderation flags, etc.

plainFields.name: virus_scan_status
plainFields.description: Result of last virus/malware scan: clean, flagged, quarantined, scan_failed, etc.

plainFields.name: scan_timestamp
plainFields.description: Last time a scan was performed.

plainFields.name: compliance_status
plainFields.description: Business/legal compliance classification: compliant, flagged, pending_review, legal_hold, expired, etc.

plainFields.name: dmca_status
plainFields.description: DMCA/copyright status for file: normal, claimed, under_review, removed, etc.

plainFields.name: moderation_status
plainFields.description: Automated or human moderation status: clean, flagged, under_review, blocked, etc.

plainFields.name: last_updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

models.name: shoppingmall_attachment_audit
models.description: Immutable audit log for all lifecycle changes to attachments. Each entry is a permanent record.

foreignFields.name: attachment_id
foreignFields.description: Attachment affected by this audit event. {@link shoppingmall_attachments.id}

plainFields.name: actor_user_id
plainFields.description: User/admin who performed the action.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of action: upload, delete, restore, quarantine, legal_hold, replace, update_metadata, etc.

plainFields.name: action_context
plainFields.description: JSON or human-readable context for the action (reason, details, IP, etc.).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Immutable timestamp for when the audit entry was created.

models.name: shoppingmall_attachment_quarantine
models.description: Tracks quarantine/judgment for attachments: files under threat, flagged for abuse, under DMCA, or regulatory review. Used for pending assessment, restriction, or forced removal. plainFields.name: quarantine_reason

plainFields.name: quarantined_by_user_id
plainFields.description: User/admin who flagged or quarantined the attachment.

plainFields.name: quarantined_at
plainFields.description: When the file was quarantined.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current quarantine status: active, released, escalated, removed, etc.

plainFields.name: release_context
plainFields.description: Details/context if/when quarantine was released (evidence, review notes, etc.).

models.name: shoppingmall_attachment_appeals
models.description: Records appeals lodged by users or sellers against attachment quarantine, moderation, or removal actions. Supports the compliance remediation/review process. Each record is a remediation request or appeal and its resolution.

plainFields.name: appealing_user_id

plainFields.name: resolution_message

plainFields.name: resolution_timestamp

models.name: shoppingmall_attachment_retention

plainFields.name: expires_at

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last updated time.

models.name: shoppingmall_attachment_incident_logs
