models.name: shoppingmall_channels
models.description: Defines each sales or marketing channel for the shoppingMall platform, such as web, mobile, external marketplaces, or brand microsites. Channels determine entry points, business rules, localization, and target audiences for the platform. Supports multi-channel expansion, configuration, and assignment of sections. Interacts with {@link shoppingmall_sections} and {@link shoppingmall_channel_templates}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: System-wide unique and immutable identifier for the channel. Must be unique across entire platform.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User- and admin-facing label; must be unique across all channels (case-insensitive).

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Type of the channel, e.g., web, mobile, marketplace, or custom. Controls channel-specific business logic and features.

plainFields.name: primary_locale
plainFields.description: Default language/region (locale code) used by channel for sorting, content, and personalization.

plainFields.name: target_audience
plainFields.description: Text description or controlled vocabulary stating target audience; used for analytics and marketing segmentation.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Whether the channel is active (true) or inactive (false). Inactive channels cannot accept new business activity.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last channel update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; if not null, channel is considered logically deleted.

models.name: shoppingmall_sections
models.description: Hierarchical navigational and organizational units within a channel, representing areas such as main sections, categories, landing pages, and campaign areas. Each section is assigned to a specific channel and can have parent/child relationships with other sections. Supports multi-level nesting for flexible IA (up to 5 levels).

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned channel's {@link shoppingmall_channels.id}. Denotes which channel this section belongs to.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Optional parent section's {@link shoppingmall_sections.id}. Supports section nesting.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique name of this section within its parent. Case-insensitive within a parent.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Section type: e.g., main, landing, campaign, special. Used for business-driven display logic.

plainFields.name: sort_index
plainFields.description: Index for explicit ordering and navigation within sibling sections. Must be unique per parent.

plainFields.name: visibility
plainFields.description: Visibility flag such as public, seller-only, or admin-only. Controls access per business role.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Whether the section is active/visible.

plainFields.name: customized
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if the section diverges from the default/template. Used for analytics and template sync.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modified timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.

models.name: shoppingmall_channel_templates
models.description: Reusable templating for rapid setup and cross-channel consistency of sections and navigation across multiple channels. Templates allow administrative control of channel IA, structure, and periodically synchronize with assigned channels. Used in onboarding, batch operations, and analytics divergence detection.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Globally unique name for the template.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Long-form description of the template's business purpose, structure, and recommended usage.

plainFields.name: template_data
plainFields.description: Serialized JSON or structured text describing the standard sections, hierarchy, parameters, and presentation logic.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the template was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last updated timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp.

models.name: shoppingmall_global_settings
models.description: Singleton or key-value storage for global, cross-channel system configuration—such as feature flags, allowed payment types, branding, regulatory settings, and system-wide constraints. Used to centrally manage operational constants and dynamic business configuration.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique system or business constant key identifier.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Current value for the defined key. May be string, serialized JSON, or control code.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Explanation of the key's purpose and business context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the setting was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of most recent update to this setting.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, if system setting is retired or changed.

models.name: shoppingmall_audit_logs
models.description: Immutable, tamper-evident logs of all major system, user, and administrative actions for compliance, troubleshooting, and analytics. Stores actor, action, context, target entity, evidence bundle (if any), and timestamps. Enables regulatory traceability and forensic review. Related to incident, evidence, and compliance tables for in-depth audit.

plainFields.name: actor_id
plainFields.description: Actor's unique id (user, admin, system component) responsible for the action taken.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Role of the actor (customer, seller, admin, system, other).

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Business or system action taken (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, ASSIGN_ROLE, SYSTEM_EVENT, etc.).

plainFields.name: target_entity
plainFields.description: Type/name of the target entity or resource being acted on (e.g., channel, user, order).

plainFields.name: target_entity_id
plainFields.description: UUID of the entity or resource where the action was targeted.

plainFields.name: context_data
plainFields.description: Structured context or snapshot payload, possibly serialized JSON, related to the operation.

plainFields.name: evidence_bundle_id
plainFields.description: Related evidence or snapshot bundle's id, if available. Links to compliance or evidence bundles.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of event occurrence; immutable record creation time.

models.name: shoppingmall_system_events
models.description: System-wide operational event log for health, scalability, notification, and error monitoring. Captures events from infrastructure, integrations, scheduled jobs, and runtime anomalies. Provides diagnostic visibility, SLA monitoring, incident reporting, and historical review for business continuity planning.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Business or technical event type (e.g., HEALTH, SCALE_UP, ERROR, JOB_RUN, BROADCAST, NOTIFICATION).

plainFields.name: severity
plainFields.description: Severity level: e.g., info, warning, error, critical. Drives alerting/notification flows.

plainFields.name: source
plainFields.description: Originating system component name or identifier (e.g., scheduler, api, integration).

plainFields.name: summary
plainFields.description: Short summary of the event for quick review.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Long-form details or structured diagnostic data. May be null if not applicable.

plainFields.name: linked_entity
plainFields.description: Optional linked business entity or type for reference (e.g., order, inventory, user).

plainFields.name: linked_entity_id
plainFields.description: Optional linked entity's id, if relevant and available.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the system event occurred.

models.name: shoppingmall_customers
models.description: End user accounts representing shopping mall customers. Includes basic authentication linkage and status tracking. Primarily referenced by orders, carts, reviews, favorites, and all customer-driven flows. Maintains only ID/auth and basic status for separation of concerns. Role assignments, sessions, and profiles handled in respective tables.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Business-unique customer email address used for authentication and notifications. Must be unique among customers.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Cryptographically hashed password for customer authentication. Not used directly for authentication; API use only.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Customer phone number for communication, verification, and security. Must be validated according to business rules.

plainFields.name: is_email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the customer's email has been confirmed through verification flow.

plainFields.name: is_phone_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the customer's phone number is verified via 2FA or onboarding flow.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current account status (enabled, disabled, pending_verification, banned, etc.). Business logic references this field to control account access.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of customer account creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to the customer record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion indicator; time at which the customer account was marked deleted. Null if active.

models.name: shoppingmall_sellers
models.description: Business seller accounts, representing organizations or individuals eligible to list and manage products, inventory, and orders on the shoppingMall. Maintains platform-level authentication and core status fields. Does not include business profile or regulatory approval details (handled in actor_profiles and verifications). Key foreign reference for products, seller dashboards, and compliance flows.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller business email, used for login and notification. Must be unique among sellers.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed secret for authentication. Regenerated on reset/role change.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Primary business contact number. Used for verification and communication; validated per business process.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current seller status (pending_approval, active, suspended, banned, etc.), controlling platform/referral access.

plainFields.name: is_email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates successful verification of seller's email address.

plainFields.name: is_phone_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates phone number verification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Date and time seller account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker for compliance retention; null if active.

models.name: shoppingmall_admins
models.description: Platform administrator records representing privileged platform operators. Includes basic login, status, and multi-factor auth linkage. Admins have access to high-audit business flows. Separation from customer/seller domains supports tighter compliance, auditability, and assignment tracking.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Admin login email, unique platform-wide. Used for authentication and notifications.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Strictly managed hashed password for admin account login. Typically rotated more frequently and subject to additional controls.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Admin contact phone, required for multi-factor authentication and audit notification. Subject to strong validation policy.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Account status (active, suspended, banned, pending_activation, etc.). Used for compliance enforcement.

plainFields.name: is_email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates if admin's email has been fully verified against registration flow.

plainFields.name: is_phone_verified
plainFields.description: Whether admin's phone has been verified for 2FA and notification.

plainFields.name: mfa_enabled
plainFields.description: Denotes if multi-factor authentication is enabled for this admin. Required for most platform operations.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when admin account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last profile/account update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete field; null for active.

models.name: shoppingmall_sessions
models.description: User session records for all types of actors on the platform (customers, sellers, admins). Tracks active login/authentication state for multi-channel, cross-device, and audit scenarios. Manages JWT/refresh tokens, session expiry, IP and device metadata, and status transitions. Sessions are essential for multi-role support and security analysis.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: References an actor record representing either a customer, seller, or admin. Use context and business validation to enforce target model. The actual relation target should be enforced by a UNION at the application layer, since multiple actor tables exist.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Indicates the session's primary role at time of login (customer, seller, admin, etc.). Guides access and permission logic.

plainFields.name: jwt_token
plainFields.description: Current valid JWT access token for session authentication and API requests.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: Valid refresh token for session resumption and multi-device login.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address at session start (and updated on session/data changes). For audit/security.

plainFields.name: device_fingerprint
plainFields.description: Device/browser fingerprint hash for session continuity, detection of suspicious activity.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current session status (active, expired, revoked, etc.). Used for access control and security workflows.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the session was last updated/renewed.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete time, if session terminated logically.

models.name: shoppingmall_role_assignments
models.description: Tracks per-actor role memberships over time. Assigns customer, seller, admin (and future roles) to a given platform actor with effective dates and assignment/audit metadata. Enables robust RBAC, multiple simultaneous role support, and complete evidentiary trails for all privilege grants and removals. Serves as an M:N link between actors and roles.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: References the profile record for the actor (customer, seller, admin, etc.) whose role is being assigned.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Role assigned (customer, seller, admin, etc.). Used for RBAC enforcement.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Assignment record status (active, revoked, pending, etc.) for auditability and rollback.

plainFields.name: granted_by
plainFields.description: Who (admin or automated process) issued this role grant. Text business identifier.

plainFields.name: assignment_reason
plainFields.description: Business or regulatory justification for assignment (e.g., onboarding, promotion, support request, compliance, etc.).

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description: Role assignment start datetime.

plainFields.name: effective_to
plainFields.description: Role assignment expiration, if limited. Null for indefinite assignments.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Assignment creation time for traceability.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

models.name: shoppingmall_actor_profiles
models.description: Core profile record for all actors (customer, seller, admin, or future types). Contains non-auth business and identification metadata, links to role assignments, and enforces person/entity uniqueness. This abstraction allows uniform handling of actors across RBAC and audit tables.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: If this actor is a customer, references the corresponding customer entity. Nullable for non-customers.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: If this actor is a seller, references the seller entity. Nullable for non-sellers.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: If this actor is an admin, references the admin entity. Nullable for non-admins.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Main display name for this actor, as shown in business and admin interfaces.

plainFields.name: profile_type
plainFields.description: Actor type classification (customer, seller, admin).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current lifecycle status (active, pending, disabled, etc.) across all actor types.

plainFields.name: created_at

event.planning:
## Error Scope Analysis
- Target Models with Validation Errors:
  - shoppingmall_channels
  - shoppingmall_customers
  - shoppingmall_sellers
  - shoppingmall_admins
  - shoppingmall_category_templates
  - shoppingmall_order_shipments
  - shoppingmall_coupon_templates
  - shoppingmall_coupons

- Error Types: All errors are for duplicated indexes (unique, plain, gin) on the same field within the same model.
- Unchanged Models: All others are preserved.

## Targeted Fixes
- Remove the GIN index for the text field if a unique or regular index (uniqueIndexes/plainIndexes) already exists on that same field, as unique and regular indexes will cover the uniqueness/query optimization, and only one GIN or regular/unique index should exist per field to avoid Prisma validation errors.
- Where the duplication is between GIN and unique index, prefer to keep unique index and remove GIN.
- For plainIndexes and ginIndexes duplication, prefer to keep plain index and remove GIN for the same field.
- All field and model descriptions must remain in English and be preserved.
- Only affect the above listed models, rest are untouched.

## Model-Specific Fix Plan
- shoppingmall_channels: Remove ginIndexes for 'display_name' (keep the unique index for uniqueness enforcement).
- shoppingmall_customers: Remove ginIndex for 'email' (keep unique index for email enforcement).
- shoppingmall_sellers: Remove ginIndex for 'email' (keep unique index).
- shoppingmall_admins: Remove ginIndex for 'email' (keep unique index).
- shoppingmall_category_templates: Remove ginIndex for 'name' (keep plain index and unique index on 'name').
- shoppingmall_order_shipments: Remove ginIndex for 'carrier' (keep plain index).
- shoppingmall_coupon_templates: Remove ginIndex for 'name' (keep unique index for uniqueness enforcement).
- shoppingmall_coupons: Remove ginIndex for 'coupon_code' (keep unique index on coupon_code).

## Minimal Output Scope
- Only the above listed models are included in output.
- ALL logic, descriptions, business constraints that are not part of duplicate indexes are left untouched for all models.

## Cross-Model Impact
- UNIQUE, plain, and GIN indexes on other fields in these models are preserved if not duplicates. All foreign key references, unique constraint logic, descriptions, and field-level doc remain untouched.
- No impact to other models which reference these models.

## Output Validation
- Return only the above models, with corrected index/gindex definitions (duplicates fixed) and all other attributes/fields untouched.
- Ensure all English descriptions are preserved.
- Confirmed: output is minimal, cross-references unaffected, all fixes in a single call.

models.name: shoppingmall_channels
models.description: Defines each sales or marketing channel for the shoppingMall platform, such as web, mobile, external marketplaces, or brand microsites. Channels determine entry points, business rules, localization, and target audiences for the platform. Supports multi-channel expansion, configuration, and assignment of sections. Interacts with {@link shoppingmall_sections} and {@link shoppingmall_channel_templates}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: System-wide unique and immutable identifier for the channel. Must be unique across entire platform.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User- and admin-facing label; must be unique across all channels (case-insensitive).

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Type of the channel, e.g., web, mobile, marketplace, or custom. Controls channel-specific business logic and features.

plainFields.name: primary_locale
plainFields.description: Default language/region (locale code) used by channel for sorting, content, and personalization.

plainFields.name: target_audience
plainFields.description: Text description or controlled vocabulary stating target audience; used for analytics and marketing segmentation.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Whether the channel is active (true) or inactive (false). Inactive channels cannot accept new business activity.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last channel update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; if not null, channel is considered logically deleted.

models.name: shoppingmall_sections
models.description: Hierarchical navigational and organizational units within a channel, representing areas such as main sections, categories, landing pages, and campaign areas. Each section is assigned to a specific channel and can have parent/child relationships with other sections. Supports multi-level nesting for flexible IA (up to 5 levels).

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned channel's {@link shoppingmall_channels.id}. Denotes which channel this section belongs to.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Optional parent section's {@link shoppingmall_sections.id}. Supports section nesting.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique name of this section within its parent. Case-insensitive within a parent.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Section type: e.g., main, landing, campaign, special. Used for business-driven display logic.

plainFields.name: sort_index
plainFields.description: Index for explicit ordering and navigation within sibling sections. Must be unique per parent.

plainFields.name: visibility
plainFields.description: Visibility flag such as public, seller-only, or admin-only. Controls access per business role.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Whether the section is active/visible.

plainFields.name: customized
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if the section diverges from the default/template. Used for analytics and template sync.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modified timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.

models.name: shoppingmall_channel_templates
models.description: Reusable templating for rapid setup and cross-channel consistency of sections and navigation across multiple channels. Templates allow administrative control of channel IA, structure, and periodically synchronize with assigned channels. Used in onboarding, batch operations, and analytics divergence detection.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Globally unique name for the template.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Long-form description of the template's business purpose, structure, and recommended usage.

plainFields.name: template_data
plainFields.description: Serialized JSON or structured text describing the standard sections, hierarchy, parameters, and presentation logic.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the template was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last updated timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp.

models.name: shoppingmall_global_settings
models.description: Singleton or key-value storage for global, cross-channel system configuration—such as feature flags, allowed payment types, branding, regulatory settings, and system-wide constraints. Used to centrally manage operational constants and dynamic business configuration.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique system or business constant key identifier.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Current value for the defined key. May be string, serialized JSON, or control code.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Explanation of the key's purpose and business context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the setting was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of most recent update to this setting.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: shoppingmall_audit_logs
models.description: Immutable, tamper-evident logs of all major system, user, and administrative actions for compliance, troubleshooting, and analytics. Stores actor, action, context, target entity, evidence bundle (if any), and timestamps. Enables regulatory traceability and forensic review. Related to incident, evidence, and compliance tables for in-depth audit.

plainFields.name: actor_id
plainFields.description: Actor's unique id (user, admin, system component) responsible for the action taken.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Role of the actor (customer, seller, admin, system, other).

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Business or system action taken (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, ASSIGN_ROLE, SYSTEM_EVENT, etc.).

plainFields.name: target_entity
plainFields.description: Type/name of the target entity or resource being acted on (e.g., channel, user, order).

plainFields.name: target_entity_id
plainFields.description: UUID of the entity or resource where the action was targeted.

plainFields.name: context_data
plainFields.description: Structured context or snapshot payload, possibly serialized JSON, related to the operation.

plainFields.name: evidence_bundle_id
plainFields.description: Related evidence or snapshot bundle's id, if available. Links to compliance or evidence bundles.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of event occurrence; immutable record creation time.

models.name: shoppingmall_system_events
models.description: System-wide operational event log for health, scalability, notification, and error monitoring. Captures events from infrastructure, integrations, scheduled jobs, and runtime anomalies. Provides diagnostic visibility, SLA monitoring, incident reporting, and historical review for business continuity planning.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Business or technical event type (e.g., HEALTH, SCALE_UP, ERROR, JOB_RUN, BROADCAST, NOTIFICATION).

plainFields.name: severity
plainFields.description: Severity level: e.g., info, warning, error, critical. Drives alerting/notification flows.

plainFields.name: source
plainFields.description: Originating system component name or identifier (e.g., scheduler, api, integration).

plainFields.name: summary
plainFields.description: Short summary of the event for quick review.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Long-form details or structured diagnostic data. May be null if not applicable.

plainFields.name: linked_entity
plainFields.description: Optional linked business entity or type for reference (e.g., order, inventory, user).

plainFields.name: linked_entity_id
plainFields.description: Optional linked entity's id, if relevant and available.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the system event occurred.

models.name: shoppingmall_customers
models.description: End user accounts representing shopping mall customers. Includes basic authentication linkage and status tracking. Primarily referenced by orders, carts, reviews, favorites, and all customer-driven flows. Maintains only ID/auth and basic status for separation of concerns. Role assignments, sessions, and profiles handled in respective tables.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Business-unique customer email address used for authentication and notifications. Must be unique among customers.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Cryptographically hashed password for customer authentication. Not used directly for authentication; API use only.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Customer phone number for communication, verification, and security. Must be validated according to business rules.

plainFields.name: is_email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the customer's email has been confirmed through verification flow.

plainFields.name: is_phone_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the customer's phone number is verified via 2FA or onboarding flow.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current account status (enabled, disabled, pending_verification, banned, etc.). Business logic references this field to control account access.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of customer account creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to the customer record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion indicator; time at which the customer account was marked deleted. Null if active.

models.name: shoppingmall_sellers
models.description: Business seller accounts, representing organizations or individuals eligible to list and manage products, inventory, and orders on the shoppingMall. Maintains platform-level authentication and core status fields. Does not include business profile or regulatory approval details (handled in actor_profiles and verifications). Key foreign reference for products, seller dashboards, and compliance flows.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller business email, used for login and notification. Must be unique among sellers.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed secret for authentication. Regenerated on reset/role change.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Primary business contact number. Used for verification and communication; validated per business process.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current seller status (pending_approval, active, suspended, banned, etc.), controlling platform/referral access.

plainFields.name: is_email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates successful verification of seller's email address.

plainFields.name: is_phone_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates phone number verification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Date and time seller account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker for compliance retention; null if active.

models.name: shoppingmall_admins
models.description: Platform administrator records representing privileged platform operators. Includes basic login, status, and multi-factor auth linkage. Admins have access to high-audit business flows. Separation from customer/seller domains supports tighter compliance, auditability, and assignment tracking.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Admin login email, unique platform-wide. Used for authentication and notifications.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Strictly managed hashed password for admin account login. Typically rotated more frequently and subject to additional controls.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Admin contact phone, required for multi-factor authentication and audit notification. Subject to strong validation policy.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Account status (active, suspended, banned, pending_activation, etc.). Used for compliance enforcement.

plainFields.name: is_email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates if admin's email has been fully verified against registration flow.

plainFields.name: is_phone_verified
plainFields.description: Whether admin's phone has been verified for 2FA and notification.

plainFields.name: mfa_enabled
plainFields.description: Denotes if multi-factor authentication is enabled for this admin. Required for most platform operations.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when admin account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last profile/account update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete field; null for active.

models.name: shoppingmall_sessions
models.description: User session records for all types of actors on the platform (customers, sellers, admins). Tracks active login/authentication state for multi-channel, cross-device, and audit scenarios. Manages JWT/refresh tokens, session expiry, IP and device metadata, and status transitions. Sessions are essential for multi-role support and security analysis.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: References an actor record representing either a customer, seller, or admin. Use context and business validation to enforce target model. The actual relation target should be enforced by a UNION at the application layer, since multiple actor tables exist.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Indicates the session's primary role at time of login (customer, seller, admin, etc.). Guides access and permission logic.

plainFields.name: jwt_token
plainFields.description: Current valid JWT access token for session authentication and API requests.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: Valid refresh token for session resumption and multi-device login.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address at session start (and updated on session/data changes). For audit/security.

plainFields.name: device_fingerprint
plainFields.description: Device/browser fingerprint hash for session continuity, detection of suspicious activity.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current session status (active, expired, revoked, etc.). Used for access control and security workflows.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the session was last updated/renewed.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete time, if session terminated logically.

models.name: shoppingmall_role_assignments
models.description: Tracks per-actor role memberships over time. Assigns customer, seller, admin (and future roles) to a given platform actor with effective dates and assignment/audit metadata. Enables robust RBAC, multiple simultaneous role support, and complete evidentiary trails for all privilege grants and removals. Serves as an M:N link between actors and roles.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: References the profile record for the actor (customer, seller, admin, etc.) whose role is being assigned.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Role assigned (customer, seller, admin, etc.). Used for RBAC enforcement.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Assignment record status (active, revoked, pending, etc.) for auditability and rollback.

plainFields.name: granted_by
plainFields.description: Who (admin or automated process) issued this role grant. Text business identifier.

plainFields.name: assignment_reason
plainFields.description: Business or regulatory justification for assignment (e.g., onboarding, promotion, support request, compliance, etc.).

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description: Role assignment start datetime.

plainFields.name: effective_to
plainFields.description: Role assignment expiration, if limited. Null for indefinite assignments.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Assignment creation time for traceability.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

models.name: shoppingmall_actor_profiles
models.description: Core profile record for all actors (customer, seller, admin, or future types). Contains non-auth business and identification metadata, links to role assignments, and enforces person/entity uniqueness. This abstraction allows uniform handling of actors across RBAC and audit tables.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: If this actor is a customer, references the corresponding customer entity. Nullable for non-customers.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: If this actor is a seller, references the seller entity. Nullable for non-sellers.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: If this actor is an admin, references the admin entity. Nullable for non-admins.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Main display name for this actor, as shown in business and admin interfaces.

plainFields.name: profile_type
plainFields.description: Actor type classification (customer, seller, admin).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current lifecycle status (active, pending, disabled, etc.) across all actor types.

plainFields.name: created_at

models.name: shoppingmall_regulatory_mappings

plainFields.name: created_at

models.name: shoppingmall_incident_reports
models.description: Formal records of business, regulatory, privacy, or compliance incidents—such as security breaches, data processing violations, or emergent legal/compliance issues. models.name: shoppingmall_channels
models.description: Defines each sales or marketing channel for the shoppingMall platform, such as web, mobile, external marketplaces, or brand microsites. Channels determine entry points, business rules, localization, and target audiences for the platform. Supports multi-channel expansion, configuration, and assignment of sections. Interacts with {@link shoppingmall_sections} and {@link shoppingmall_channel_templates}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: System-wide unique and immutable identifier for the channel. Must be unique across entire platform.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User- and admin-facing label; must be unique across all channels (case-insensitive).

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Type of the channel, e.g., web, mobile, marketplace, or custom. Controls channel-specific business logic and features.

plainFields.name: primary_locale
plainFields.description: Default language/region (locale code) used by channel for sorting, content, and personalization.

plainFields.name: target_audience
plainFields.description: Text description or controlled vocabulary stating target audience; used for analytics and marketing segmentation.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Whether the channel is active (true) or inactive (false). Inactive channels cannot accept new business activity.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last channel update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; if not null, channel is considered logically deleted.

models.name: shoppingmall_sections
models.description: Hierarchical navigational and organizational units within a channel, representing areas such as main sections, categories, landing pages, and campaign areas. Each section is assigned to a specific channel and can have parent/child relationships with other sections. Supports multi-level nesting for flexible IA (up to 5 levels).

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned channel's {@link shoppingmall_channels.id}. Denotes which channel this section belongs to.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Optional parent section's {@link shoppingmall_sections.id}. Supports section nesting.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique name of this section within its parent. Case-insensitive within a parent.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Section type: e.g., main, landing, campaign, special. Used for business-driven display logic.

plainFields.name: sort_index
plainFields.description: Index for explicit ordering and navigation within sibling sections. Must be unique per parent.

plainFields.name: visibility
plainFields.description: Visibility flag such as public, seller-only, or admin-only. Controls access per business role.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Whether the section is active/visible.

plainFields.name: customized
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if the section diverges from the default/template. Used for analytics and template sync.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modified timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.

models.name: shoppingmall_channel_templates
models.description: Reusable templating for rapid setup and cross-channel consistency of sections and navigation across multiple channels. Templates allow administrative control of channel IA, structure, and periodically synchronize with assigned channels. Used in onboarding, batch operations, and analytics divergence detection.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Globally unique name for the template.

plainFields.name: description

plainFields.name: template_data
plainFields.description: Serialized JSON or structured text describing the standard sections, hierarchy, parameters, and presentation logic.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the template was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last updated timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp.

models.name: shoppingmall_global_settings
models.description: Singleton or key-value storage for global, cross-channel system configuration—such as feature flags, allowed payment types, branding, regulatory settings, and system-wide constraints. Used to centrally manage operational constants and dynamic business configuration.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique system or business constant key identifier.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Current value for the defined key. May be string, serialized JSON, or control code.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Explanation of the key's purpose and business context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the setting was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of most recent update to this setting.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, if system setting is retired or changed.

models.name: shoppingmall_audit_logs
models.description: Immutable, tamper-evident logs of all major system, user, and administrative actions for compliance, troubleshooting, and analytics. Stores actor, action, context, target entity, evidence bundle (if any), and timestamps. Enables regulatory traceability and forensic review. Related to incident, evidence, and compliance tables for in-depth audit.

plainFields.name: actor_id
plainFields.description: Actor's unique id (user, admin, system component) responsible for the action taken.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Role of the actor (customer, seller, admin, system, other).

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Business or system action taken (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, ASSIGN_ROLE, SYSTEM_EVENT, etc.).

plainFields.name: target_entity
plainFields.description: Type/name of the target entity or resource being acted on (e.g., channel, user, order).

plainFields.name: target_entity_id
plainFields.description: UUID of the entity or resource where the action was targeted.

plainFields.name: context_data
plainFields.description: Structured context or snapshot payload, possibly serialized JSON, related to the operation.

plainFields.name: evidence_bundle_id
plainFields.description: Related evidence or snapshot bundle's id, if available. Links to compliance or evidence bundles.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of event occurrence; immutable record creation time.

models.name: shoppingmall_system_events
models.description: System-wide operational event log for health, scalability, notification, and error monitoring. Captures events from infrastructure, integrations, scheduled jobs, and runtime anomalies. Provides diagnostic visibility, SLA monitoring, incident reporting, and historical review for business continuity planning.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Business or technical event type (e.g., HEALTH, SCALE_UP, ERROR, JOB_RUN, BROADCAST, NOTIFICATION).

plainFields.name: severity
plainFields.description: Severity level: e.g., info, warning, error, critical. Drives alerting/notification flows.

plainFields.name: source
plainFields.description: Originating system component name or identifier (e.g., scheduler, api, integration).

plainFields.name: summary
plainFields.description: Short summary of the event for quick review.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Long-form details or structured diagnostic data. May be null if not applicable.

plainFields.name: linked_entity
plainFields.description: Optional linked business entity or type for reference (e.g., order, inventory, user).

plainFields.name: linked_entity_id
plainFields.description: Optional linked entity's id, if relevant and available.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the system event occurred.

models.name: shoppingmall_customers
models.description: End user accounts representing shopping mall customers. Includes basic authentication linkage and status tracking. Primarily referenced by orders, carts, reviews, favorites, and all customer-driven flows. Maintains only ID/auth and basic status for separation of concerns. Role assignments, sessions, and profiles handled in respective tables.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Business-unique customer email address used for authentication and notifications. Must be unique among customers.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Cryptographically hashed password for customer authentication. Not used directly for authentication; API use only.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Customer phone number for communication, verification, and security. Must be validated according to business rules.

plainFields.name: is_email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the customer's email has been confirmed through verification flow.

plainFields.name: is_phone_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the customer's phone number is verified via 2FA or onboarding flow.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current account status (enabled, disabled, pending_verification, banned, etc.). Business logic references this field to control account access.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of customer account creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to the customer record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion indicator; time at which the customer account was marked deleted. Null if active.

models.name: shoppingmall_sellers
models.description: Business seller accounts, representing organizations or individuals eligible to list and manage products, inventory, and orders on the shoppingMall. Maintains platform-level authentication and core status fields. Does not include business profile or regulatory approval details (handled in actor_profiles and verifications). Key foreign reference for products, seller dashboards, and compliance flows.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller business email, used for login and notification. Must be unique among sellers.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed secret for authentication. Regenerated on reset/role change.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Primary business contact number. Used for verification and communication; validated per business process.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current seller status (pending_approval, active, suspended, banned, etc.), controlling platform/referral access.

plainFields.name: is_email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates successful verification of seller's email address.

plainFields.name: is_phone_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates phone number verification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Date and time seller account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker for compliance retention; null if active.

models.name: shoppingmall_admins
models.description: Platform administrator records representing privileged platform operators. Includes basic login, status, and multi-factor auth linkage. Admins have access to high-audit business flows. Separation from customer/seller domains supports tighter compliance, auditability, and assignment tracking.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Admin login email, unique platform-wide. Used for authentication and notifications.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Strictly managed hashed password for admin account login. Typically rotated more frequently and subject to additional controls.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Admin contact phone, required for multi-factor authentication and audit notification. Subject to strong validation policy.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Account status (active, suspended, banned, pending_activation, etc.). Used for compliance enforcement.

plainFields.name: is_email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates if admin's email has been fully verified against registration flow.

plainFields.name: is_phone_verified
plainFields.description: Whether admin's phone has been verified for 2FA and notification.

plainFields.name: mfa_enabled
plainFields.description: Denotes if multi-factor authentication is enabled for this admin. Required for most platform operations.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when admin account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last profile/account update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete field; null for active.

models.name: shoppingmall_sessions
models.description: User session records for all types of actors on the platform (customers, sellers, admins). Tracks active login/authentication state for multi-channel, cross-device, and audit scenarios. Manages JWT/refresh tokens, session expiry, IP and device metadata, and status transitions. Sessions are essential for multi-role support and security analysis.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: References an actor record representing either a customer, seller, or admin. Use context and business validation to enforce target model. The actual relation target should be enforced by a UNION at the application layer, since multiple actor tables exist.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Indicates the session's primary role at time of login (customer, seller, admin, etc.). Guides access and permission logic.

plainFields.name: jwt_token
plainFields.description: Current valid JWT access token for session authentication and API requests.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: Valid refresh token for session resumption and multi-device login.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address at session start (and updated on session/data changes). For audit/security.

plainFields.name: device_fingerprint
plainFields.description: Device/browser fingerprint hash for session continuity, detection of suspicious activity.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current session status (active, expired, revoked, etc.). Used for access control and security workflows.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the session was last updated/renewed.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete time, if session terminated logically.

models.name: shoppingmall_role_assignments
models.description: Tracks per-actor role memberships over time. Assigns customer, seller, admin (and future roles) to a given platform actor with effective dates and assignment/audit metadata. Enables robust RBAC, multiple simultaneous role support, and complete evidentiary trails for all privilege grants and removals. Serves as an M:N link between actors and roles.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: References the profile record for the actor (customer, seller, admin, etc.) whose role is being assigned.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Role assigned (customer, seller, admin, etc.). Used for RBAC enforcement.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Assignment record status (active, revoked, pending, etc.) for auditability and rollback.

plainFields.name: granted_by
plainFields.description: Who (admin or automated process) issued this role grant. Text business identifier.

plainFields.name: assignment_reason
plainFields.description: Business or regulatory justification for assignment (e.g., onboarding, promotion, support request, compliance, etc.).

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description: Role assignment start datetime.

plainFields.name: effective_to
plainFields.description: Role assignment expiration, if limited. Null for indefinite assignments.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Assignment creation time for traceability.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

models.name: shoppingmall_actor_profiles
models.description: Core profile record for all actors (customer, seller, admin, or future types). This abstraction allows uniform handling of actors across RBAC and audit tables.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: If this actor is a customer, references the corresponding customer entity. Nullable for non-customers.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: If this actor is a seller, references the seller entity. Nullable for non-sellers.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: If this actor is an admin, references the admin entity. Nullable for non-admins.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Main display name for this actor, as shown in business and admin interfaces.

plainFields.name: profile_type
plainFields.description: Actor type classification (customer, seller, admin).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current lifecycle status (active, pending, disabled, etc.) across all actor types.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Profile creation timestamp. Not always same as initial role join date.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update to actor's profile.

models.name: shoppingmall_auth_verifications
models.description: Manages authentication/verification workflows for actors: 2FA tokens, email/phone verification, password resets, device and session validates. foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: References the actor profile for whom this verification was issued.

plainFields.name: verification_type
plainFields.description: Type of verification or token purpose (email, phone, password_reset, mfa, onboarding, etc.).

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secret/token used as proof of verification or reset intent. Generally time-limited/one-time-use.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Lifecycle status of the token (pending, used, expired, revoked, etc.).

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiry date/time of this verification token or record.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: When the token was actually used (null if not yet used/expired).

plainFields.name: issued_at
plainFields.description: When the token or secret was issued to the actor.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the verification record was created in the system log.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update to the record (e.g., on use, revocation, auto-expiry).

models.name: shoppingmall_role_change_audits
models.description: Immutable audit trail for all role grant/revocation/change actions. Permanent evidence supporting regulatory, legal, and trust/abuse investigations. foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: Actor profile directly affected by the role change event.

plainFields.name: event_type

plainFields.name: old_role

plainFields.name: new_role

plainFields.name: changed_by
plainFields.description: The business identifier for the user/admin/process who initiated the role change.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Human or system-entered justification for the role mutation; used for compliance/audit discovery.

plainFields.name: change_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp event occurred as recorded by system clock.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time for audit traceability.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update applied (should only be timestamped for technical adjustments, never for business content changes).

foreignFields.name: shoppingmall_seller_id

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name/title for catalog and search display.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Long-form product description, supports rich text/markdown for customer detail.

plainFields.name: base_price

plainFields.name: currency

plainFields.name: status

plainFields.name: main_image_uri
plainFields.description: Primary display image URI for fast catalog rendering.

plainFields.name: main_video_uri
plainFields.description: Primary display video URI for product feature/preview (e.g., for video-rich listings).

plainFields.name: sort_index

plainFields.name: compliance_flag
plainFields.description: Whether this product is flagged for compliance/business review (true = under review or hold).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Product creation timestamp.

### `shoppingmall_channels`

Defines each sales or marketing channel for the shoppingMall platform,
such as web, mobile, external marketplaces, or brand microsites. Channels
determine entry points, business rules, localization, and target
audiences for the platform. Supports multi-channel expansion,
configuration, and assignment of sections. Interacts with {@link
shoppingmall_sections} and [shoppingmall_channel_templates](#shoppingmall_channel_templates).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `code`
  > System-wide unique and immutable identifier for the channel. Must be
  > unique across entire platform.
- `display_name`
  > User- and admin-facing label; must be unique across all channels
  > (case-insensitive).
- `type`
  > Type of the channel, e.g., web, mobile, marketplace, or custom. Controls
  > channel-specific business logic and features.
- `primary_locale`
  > Default language/region (locale code) used by channel for sorting,
  > content, and personalization.
- `target_audience`
  > Text description or controlled vocabulary stating target audience; used
  > for analytics and marketing segmentation.
- `active`
  > Whether the channel is active (true) or inactive (false). Inactive
  > channels cannot accept new business activity.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the channel was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of last channel update.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp; if not null, channel is considered logically
  > deleted.

### `shoppingmall_sections`

Hierarchical navigational and organizational units within a channel,
representing areas such as main sections, categories, landing pages, and
campaign areas. Each section is assigned to a specific channel and can
have parent/child relationships with other sections. Supports multi-level
nesting for flexible IA (up to 5 levels).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shoppingmall_channel_id`
  > Assigned channel's [shoppingmall_channels.id](#shoppingmall_channels). Denotes which
  > channel this section belongs to.
- `parent_id`
  > Optional parent section's [shoppingmall_sections.id](#shoppingmall_sections). Supports
  > section nesting.
- `name`
  > Unique name of this section within its parent. Case-insensitive within a
  > parent.
- `type`
  > Section type: e.g., main, landing, campaign, special. Used for
  > business-driven display logic.
- `sort_index`
  > Index for explicit ordering and navigation within sibling sections. Must
  > be unique per parent.
- `visibility`
  > Visibility flag such as public, seller-only, or admin-only. Controls
  > access per business role.
- `active`: Whether the section is active/visible.
- `customized`
  > Flag indicating if the section diverges from the default/template. Used
  > for analytics and template sync.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the section was created.
- `updated_at`: Last modified timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.

### `shoppingmall_channel_templates`

Reusable templating for rapid setup and cross-channel consistency of
sections and navigation across multiple channels. Templates allow
administrative control of channel IA, structure, and periodically
synchronize with assigned channels. Used in onboarding, batch operations,
and analytics divergence detection.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `name`: Globally unique name for the template.
- `description`
  > Long-form description of the template's business purpose, structure, and
  > recommended usage.
- `template_data`
  > Serialized JSON or structured text describing the standard sections,
  > hierarchy, parameters, and presentation logic.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the template was created.
- `updated_at`: Last updated timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp.

### `shoppingmall_global_settings`

Singleton or key-value storage for global, cross-channel system
configuration—such as feature flags, allowed payment types, branding,
regulatory settings, and system-wide constraints. Used to centrally
manage operational constants and dynamic business configuration.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `key`: Unique system or business constant key identifier.
- `value`
  > Current value for the defined key. May be string, serialized JSON, or
  > control code.
- `description`: Explanation of the key's purpose and business context.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the setting was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of most recent update to this setting.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if system setting is retired or changed.

### `shoppingmall_audit_logs`

Immutable, tamper-evident logs of all major system, user, and
administrative actions for compliance, troubleshooting, and analytics.
Stores actor, action, context, target entity, evidence bundle (if any),
and timestamps. Enables regulatory traceability and forensic review.
Related to incident, evidence, and compliance tables for in-depth audit.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `actor_id`
  > Actor's unique id (user, admin, system component) responsible for the
  > action taken.
- `role`: Role of the actor (customer, seller, admin, system, other).
- `action_type`
  > Business or system action taken (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, ASSIGN_ROLE,
  > SYSTEM_EVENT, etc.).
- `target_entity`
  > Type/name of the target entity or resource being acted on (e.g., channel,
  > user, order).
- `target_entity_id`: UUID of the entity or resource where the action was targeted.
- `context_data`
  > Structured context or snapshot payload, possibly serialized JSON, related
  > to the operation.
- `evidence_bundle_id`
  > Related evidence or snapshot bundle's id, if available. Links to
  > compliance or evidence bundles.
- `created_at`: Timestamp of event occurrence; immutable record creation time.

### `shoppingmall_system_events`

System-wide operational event log for health, scalability, notification,
and error monitoring. Captures events from infrastructure, integrations,
scheduled jobs, and runtime anomalies. Provides diagnostic visibility,
SLA monitoring, incident reporting, and historical review for business
continuity planning.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `event_type`
  > Business or technical event type (e.g., HEALTH, SCALE_UP, ERROR, JOB_RUN,
  > BROADCAST, NOTIFICATION).
- `severity`
  > Severity level: e.g., info, warning, error, critical. Drives
  > alerting/notification flows.
- `source`
  > Originating system component name or identifier (e.g., scheduler, api,
  > integration).
- `summary`: Short summary of the event for quick review.
- `details`
  > Long-form details or structured diagnostic data. May be null if not
  > applicable.
- `linked_entity`
  > Optional linked business entity or type for reference (e.g., order,
  > inventory, user).
- `linked_entity_id`: Optional linked entity's id, if relevant and available.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the system event occurred.

### `shoppingmall_customers`

End user accounts representing shopping mall customers. Includes basic
authentication linkage and status tracking. Primarily referenced by
orders, carts, reviews, favorites, and all customer-driven flows.
Maintains only ID/auth and basic status for separation of concerns. Role
assignments, sessions, and profiles handled in respective tables.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`
  > Business-unique customer email address used for authentication and
  > notifications. Must be unique among customers.
- `password_hash`
  > Cryptographically hashed password for customer authentication. Not used
  > directly for authentication; API use only.
- `phone`
  > Customer phone number for communication, verification, and security. Must
  > be validated according to business rules.
- `is_email_verified`
  > Indicates whether the customer's email has been confirmed through
  > verification flow.
- `is_phone_verified`
  > Indicates whether the customer's phone number is verified via 2FA or
  > onboarding flow.
- `status`
  > Current account status (enabled, disabled, pending_verification, banned,
  > etc.). Business logic references this field to control account access.
- `created_at`: Timestamp of customer account creation.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of last update to the customer record.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion indicator; time at which the customer account was marked
  > deleted. Null if active.

### `shoppingmall_sellers`

Business seller accounts, representing organizations or individuals
eligible to list and manage products, inventory, and orders on the
shoppingMall. Maintains platform-level authentication and core status
fields. Does not include business profile or regulatory approval details
(handled in actor_profiles and verifications). Key foreign reference for
products, seller dashboards, and compliance flows.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`
  > Seller business email, used for login and notification. Must be unique
  > among sellers.
- `password_hash`: Hashed secret for authentication. Regenerated on reset/role change.
- `phone`
  > Primary business contact number. Used for verification and communication;
  > validated per business process.
- `status`
  > Current seller status (pending_approval, active, suspended, banned,
  > etc.), controlling platform/referral access.
- `is_email_verified`: Indicates successful verification of seller's email address.
- `is_phone_verified`: Indicates phone number verification.
- `created_at`: Date and time seller account was created.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete marker for compliance retention; null if active.

### `shoppingmall_admins`

Platform administrator records representing privileged platform
operators. Includes basic login, status, and multi-factor auth linkage.
Admins have access to high-audit business flows. Separation from
customer/seller domains supports tighter compliance, auditability, and
assignment tracking.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`
  > Admin login email, unique platform-wide. Used for authentication and
  > notifications.
- `password_hash`
  > Strictly managed hashed password for admin account login. Typically
  > rotated more frequently and subject to additional controls.
- `phone`
  > Admin contact phone, required for multi-factor authentication and audit
  > notification. Subject to strong validation policy.
- `status`
  > Account status (active, suspended, banned, pending_activation, etc.).
  > Used for compliance enforcement.
- `is_email_verified`
  > Indicates if admin's email has been fully verified against registration
  > flow.
- `is_phone_verified`: Whether admin's phone has been verified for 2FA and notification.
- `mfa_enabled`
  > Denotes if multi-factor authentication is enabled for this admin.
  > Required for most platform operations.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when admin account was created.
- `updated_at`: Last profile/account update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete field; null for active.

### `shoppingmall_sessions`

User session records for all types of actors on the platform (customers,
sellers, admins). Tracks active login/authentication state for
multi-channel, cross-device, and audit scenarios. Manages JWT/refresh
tokens, session expiry, IP and device metadata, and status transitions.
Sessions are essential for multi-role support and security analysis.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `actor_id`
  > References an actor record representing either a customer, seller, or
  > admin. Use context and business validation to enforce target model. The
  > actual relation target should be enforced by a UNION at the application
  > layer, since multiple actor tables exist.
- `role`
  > Indicates the session's primary role at time of login (customer, seller,
  > admin, etc.). Guides access and permission logic.
- `jwt_token`
  > Current valid JWT access token for session authentication and API
  > requests.
- `refresh_token`: Valid refresh token for session resumption and multi-device login.
- `ip_address`
  > IP address at session start (and updated on session/data changes). For
  > audit/security.
- `device_fingerprint`
  > Device/browser fingerprint hash for session continuity, detection of
  > suspicious activity.
- `status`
  > Current session status (active, expired, revoked, etc.). Used for access
  > control and security workflows.
- `expires_at`: Session expiration timestamp.
- `created_at`: Session creation time.
- `updated_at`: When the session was last updated/renewed.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete time, if session terminated logically.

### `shoppingmall_role_assignments`

Tracks per-actor role memberships over time. Assigns customer, seller,
admin (and future roles) to a given platform actor with effective dates
and assignment/audit metadata. Enables robust RBAC, multiple simultaneous
role support, and complete evidentiary trails for all privilege grants
and removals. Serves as an M:N link between actors and roles.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `actor_id`
  > References the profile record for the actor (customer, seller, admin,
  > etc.) whose role is being assigned.
- `role`: Role assigned (customer, seller, admin, etc.). Used for RBAC enforcement.
- `status`
  > Assignment record status (active, revoked, pending, etc.) for
  > auditability and rollback.
- `granted_by`
  > Who (admin or automated process) issued this role grant. Text business
  > identifier.
- `assignment_reason`
  > Business or regulatory justification for assignment (e.g., onboarding,
  > promotion, support request, compliance, etc.).
- `effective_from`: Role assignment start datetime.
- `effective_to`: Role assignment expiration, if limited. Null for indefinite assignments.
- `created_at`: Assignment creation time for traceability.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.

### `shoppingmall_actor_profiles`

Core profile record for all actors (customer, seller, admin, or future
types). Contains non-auth business and identification metadata, links to
role assignments, and enforces person/entity uniqueness. This abstraction
allows uniform handling of actors across RBAC and audit tables.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `customer_id`
  > If this actor is a customer, references the corresponding customer
  > entity. Nullable for non-customers.
- `seller_id`
  > If this actor is a seller, references the seller entity. Nullable for
  > non-sellers.
- `admin_id`
  > If this actor is an admin, references the admin entity. Nullable for
  > non-admins.
- `display_name`
  > Main display name for this actor, as shown in business and admin
  > interfaces.
- `profile_type`: Actor type classification (customer, seller, admin).
- `status`
  > Current lifecycle status (active, pending, disabled, etc.) across all
  > actor types.
- `created_at`: Profile creation timestamp. Not always same as initial role join date.
- `updated_at`: Last update to actor's profile.

### `shoppingmall_auth_verifications`

Manages authentication/verification workflows for actors: 2FA tokens,
email/phone verification, password resets, device and session validates.
Linked to actor profile, with strong audit controls. Trackable by status,
expiry, intent, and used for compliance evidence of verification status
at point-in-time.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `actor_id`: References the actor profile for whom this verification was issued.
- `verification_type`
  > Type of verification or token purpose (email, phone, password_reset, mfa,
  > onboarding, etc.).
- `token`
  > Secret/token used as proof of verification or reset intent. Generally
  > time-limited/one-time-use.
- `status`: Lifecycle status of the token (pending, used, expired, revoked, etc.).
- `expires_at`: Expiry date/time of this verification token or record.
- `used_at`: When the token was actually used (null if not yet used/expired).
- `issued_at`: When the token or secret was issued to the actor.
- `created_at`: When the verification record was created in the system log.
- `updated_at`: Last update to the record (e.g., on use, revocation, auto-expiry).

### `shoppingmall_role_change_audits`

Immutable audit trail for all role grant/revocation/change actions.
Permanent evidence supporting regulatory, legal, and trust/abuse
investigations. Captures before/after role states, actor, initiator,
timestamps, justifications, and business context. Used extensively by
compliance monitoring and admin dashboards.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `actor_id`: Actor profile directly affected by the role change event.
- `event_type`: Role change event type (grant, revoke, expire, escalate, demote, etc.).
- `old_role`: Role the actor held prior to event.
- `new_role`: Role assigned by this event (null for demote/revoke lapses).
- `changed_by`
  > The business identifier for the user/admin/process who initiated the role
  > change.
- `reason`
  > Human or system-entered justification for the role mutation; used for
  > compliance/audit discovery.
- `change_at`: Timestamp event occurred as recorded by system clock.
- `created_at`: Record creation time for audit traceability.
- `updated_at`
  > Last update applied (should only be timestamped for technical
  > adjustments, never for business content changes).
