### `shoppingmall_business_rules`

Catalog of universal business rules, constraints, and policies enforced
platform-wide. Allows for dynamic rule management, audit, and rapid
update across the system. Relationships include rule assignments to
entities and audit trails for changes. Not tied to transactional records;
only stores the authoritative definition, scope, and core logic metadata.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `code`
  > Unique business rule code identifier (e.g., BR-1001). Used for
  > referencing in assignments and audit logs.
- `title`: Human-readable name of the business rule.
- `description`
  > Detailed narrative/business context of the rule for documentation and
  > compliance reporting.
- `rule_scope`
  > The scope of applicability (e.g., 'order', 'product', 'payment', or
  > global).
- `active`: Whether the rule is currently active and enforced.
- `priority`
  > Relative enforcement priority: lower is higher priority. Used for
  > sequencing validation.
- `created_at`: Rule creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp; null if active.

### `shoppingmall_rule_assignments`

Assignments linking business rules to specific objects/entities (e.g.,
product, order, user). Enables dynamic rule targeting, compliance
validation, and context-scoped enforcement.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shoppingmall_business_rule_id`: Target business rule's [shoppingmall_business_rules.id](#shoppingmall_business_rules).
- `target_type`
  > Entity type this assignment refers to (e.g., 'order', 'product', 'user',
  > etc.).
- `target_id`: UUID of the specific object/entity being targeted for rule assignment.
- `applied_context`
  > Contextual marker (e.g., channel or regional scope) for assignment;
  > supports multi-context rules.
- `assigned_at`: Assignment creation timestamp.
- `expired_at`: Assignment expiration timestamp (null if ongoing/active).
- `created_at`: Timestamp of assignment record creation.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for assignment.

### `shoppingmall_rule_applications`

Tracks the application of a business rule to a specific context or event,
including pass/fail and evidence references. Used for compliance proof
and auditability of rule logic execution.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shoppingmall_business_rule_id`: Applied rule's [shoppingmall_business_rules.id](#shoppingmall_business_rules).
- `shoppingmall_rule_assignment_id`: Target rule assignment's [shoppingmall_rule_assignments.id](#shoppingmall_rule_assignments).
- `application_context`
  > Narrative/context in which the rule was applied (e.g., 'order_checkout',
  > 'payment_refund').
- `triggered_at`: Timestamp when rule was applied.
- `passed`: True if the rule passed; false if it was violated.
- `evidence_bundle_id`
  > Reference to evidence supporting this application (links to
  > shoppingmall_evidence_bundles.id).
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record update timestamp.

### `shoppingmall_validation_errors`

Catalog and record of validation error codes and messages returned by
rule engine/application logic. Used for traceability, developer
reference, and compliance error reporting/auditing.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `error_code`: Unique validation error code (e.g. ERR_MIN_VALUE, ORDER_NOT_FOUND).
- `message`: Human-readable error message template for display, audit, or localization.
- `documentation_uri`: Link to documentation or knowledge base entry explaining the error code.
- `severity`: Business-defined severity level (e.g. info, warning, error, critical).
- `deprecated`: Whether this error has been deprecated or replaced in business flows.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp; null if active.

### `shoppingmall_evidence_bundles`

Stores hashes, digital signatures, file references, and context for
evidence collected during rule application, audit, or compliance
investigation. Central to demonstrating regulatory and legal compliance;
supports linking to external object storage.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `bundle_hash`: Unique hash/digest representing this evidence bundle (e.g., SHA256).
- `description`: Narrative describing evidence context, purpose, or chain of custody.
- `external_reference_uri`: Optional URI to external evidence file or system (e.g., S3, Azure Blob).
- `created_by_actor_id`: Actor (user/admin/service) that collected or submitted the evidence.
- `created_at`: Evidence creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp; null if active.

### `shoppingmall_legal_holds`

Represents business records under legal or regulatory hold, preventing
deletion/modification pending investigation or compliance actions.
References evidence bundles and target objects bound by hold.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `evidence_bundle_id`: Linked evidence bundle's [shoppingmall_evidence_bundles.id](#shoppingmall_evidence_bundles).
- `target_type`: Type of object under legal hold (e.g., 'order', 'product', 'user', etc.).
- `target_id`: UUID of object under hold.
- `hold_reason`: Reason for legal hold; business/narrative context.
- `hold_status`: Status code (e.g., active, released, expired).
- `applied_by_actor_id`: Actor applying the legal hold (typically admin/authority).
- `applied_at`: Timestamp of hold application.
- `released_at`: Timestamp when hold was released (null if active).
- `created_at`: Legal hold record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Legal hold record update timestamp.

### `shoppingmall_regulatory_mappings`

Mappings and metadata linking business rules, products/services, or
actions to relevant regulatory regimes or compliance codes (e.g., GDPR,
CCPA, SOX). Supports audit and regulatory reporting across regions and
legal domains.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shoppingmall_business_rule_id`: Linked business rule's [shoppingmall_business_rules.id](#shoppingmall_business_rules).
- `regime_code`: Regulatory code identifier (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
- `jurisdiction`: Geographic or legal jurisdiction this mapping applies to.
- `reference_uri`: Link to regulatory documentation, compliance portal, or audit page.
- `mapping_type`
  > Type of business-relevant mapping (e.g., evidence, notification, data
  > export, audit).
- `mapping_status`: Status (active, deprecated, superseded).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Update timestamp.

### `shoppingmall_compliance_events`

Record of compliance-related events, such as audits, regulatory
inquiries, or major business rule changes. Used for policy review,
compliance audit, and incident response. Can reference external objects
(by UUID) and evidence bundles.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `evidence_bundle_id`
  > Linked evidence bundle for this event's documentation {@link
  > shoppingmall_evidence_bundles.id}.
- `event_type`: Business event type (e.g., audit, report, inquiry, breach, remediation).
- `event_status`: Event status code (open, resolved, under_review, etc.).
- `summary`: Brief summary/narrative of the compliance event.
- `description`: Extended textual description or findings from event/audit.
- `related_object_type`: Type of entity affected by or origin of event.
- `related_object_id`: UUID of related entity.
- `occurred_at`: Timestamp at which event occurred.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record update timestamp.

### `shoppingmall_rules_audit`

Audit log of business rule changes, assignments, applications, and status
transitions. Central for system-wide auditability, regulatory compliance
evidence, and admin controls. Logs all actions on rules including who,
what, when, reason, and chain of historical changes.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shoppingmall_business_rule_id`: Associated rule's [shoppingmall_business_rules.id](#shoppingmall_business_rules).
- `action_type`: Type of action taken on the rule (created, updated, assigned, etc.).
- `performed_by_actor_id`: User/admin/service who performed the action.
- `performed_at`: Timestamp when action was performed.
- `change_summary`: Brief summary of the change/action for fast audit review.
- `change_description`: Detailed description or rationale for change.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.

### `shoppingmall_incident_reports`

Formal records of business, regulatory, privacy, or compliance
incidents—such as security breaches, data processing violations, or
emergent legal/compliance issues. Used to drive remediation and meet
regulatory notification requirements. Includes incident status, impact,
evidence, and full timeline data up to resolution.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `evidence_bundle_id`
  > Evidence bundle providing factual foundation for incident. Links to
  > shoppingmall_evidence_bundles.id.
- `incident_type`
  > Type of incident (data_breach, policy_violation, regulatory_inquiry,
  > etc.).
- `incident_status`
  > Incident status code (open, mitigated, resolved, escalated,
  > under_investigation, etc.).
- `impact_summary`: Narrative summary of incident business impact/outcome.
- `timeline`
  > Structured or free-text report of incident event sequence (may be
  > JSON/text).
- `reported_by_actor_id`: User/admin/service who submitted the report.
- `reported_at`: Timestamp of initial report submission.
- `resolved_at`: Timestamp of incident resolution (null if unresolved).
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record update timestamp.
